uzbekDefinition: To'xtovsiz nolimoq yoki norozilik bildirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Lawrence always gripes when he has to do chores.
exampleSentenceUz: Lourens uy yumushlarini bajarishi kerak bo'lganda doim noliydi.
englishDefinition: To gripe means to complain constantly.

definition: When something is grueling, it is very hard to do.
exampleSentence: The climber faced the grueling task of reaching the top of the steep mountain.
uzbekDefinition: Bajarish uchun juda ko'p kuch va sabr talab qiladigan og'ir ish.
exampleSentenceEn: The climber faced the grueling task of reaching the top of the steep mountain.
exampleSentenceUz: Alpinist tik tog' cho'qqisiga chiqishdek mashaqqatli vazifaga duch keldi.
englishDefinition: When something is grueling, it is very hard to do.

definition: When something is mundane, it is boring, common, or ordinary.
exampleSentence: The man had the mundane chore of raking thousands of leaves into piles.
uzbekDefinition: Har kunlik, hech qanday o'ziga xosligi bo'lmagan zerikarli narsa.
exampleSentenceEn: The man had the mundane chore of raking thousands of leaves into piles.
exampleSentenceUz: Erkak minglab barglarni to'plashdek zerikarli yumush bilan band edi.
englishDefinition: When something is mundane, it is boring, common, or ordinary.

definition: To opt is to make a choice, especially when deciding in favor of something.
exampleSentence: My brother likes chocolate ice cream, but I always opt for vanilla.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani boshqasidan afzal ko'rib tanlov qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: My brother likes chocolate ice cream, but I always opt for vanilla.
exampleSentenceUz: Akam shokoladli muzqaymoqni yoqtiradi, men esa doim vanillinisini tanlayman.
englishDefinition: To opt is to make a choice, especially when deciding in favor of something.

definition: Outrage is a very strong emotion of anger or shock.
exampleSentence: Tommy was feeling outrage when his parents said he couldn't go to the dance.
uzbekDefinition: Juda kuchli g'azab yoki hayrat aralash achchiqlanish tuyg'usi.
exampleSentenceEn: Tommy was feeling outrage when his parents said he couldn't go to the dance.
exampleSentenceUz: Ota-onasi raqs kechasiga borishga ruxsat bermaganda Tommi qattiq g'azablandi.
englishDefinition: Outrage is a very strong emotion of anger or shock.

definition: When an amount of something is paltry, it is very small.
exampleSentence: The poor man had a paltry sum of money.
uzbekDefinition: Miqdori yoki ahamiyati jihatidan juda kam va ahamiyatsiz.
exampleSentenceEn: The poor man had a paltry sum of money.
exampleSentenceUz: Kambag'al odamning qo'lida arzimas miqdorda pul bor edi.
englishDefinition: When an amount of something is paltry, it is very small.

definition: To rectify something means to correct it.
exampleSentence: I quickly rectified the spelling mistakes that I had on my essay.
uzbekDefinition: Xato yoki kamchilikni bartaraf etib to'g'ri holga keltirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: I quickly rectified the spelling mistakes that I had on my essay.
exampleSentenceUz: Inshomdagi imlo xatolarini darhol tuzatib chiqdim.
englishDefinition: To rectify something means to correct it.

definition: When someone is resourceful, they are good at dealing with hard situations.
exampleSentence: After his boat sunk, Matt was resourceful enough to build a raft.
uzbekDefinition: Qiyin vaziyatlardan chiqish yo'lini tez va aqlli topa oladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: After his boat sunk, Matt was resourceful enough to build a raft.
exampleSentenceUz: Qayig'i cho'kib ketgach, Mett sol yasashga yetarli darajada tadbirkorlik ko'rsatdi.
englishDefinition: When someone is resourceful, they are good at dealing with hard situations.

definition: Sustenance is food and water needed to keep a person, animal, or plant alive.
exampleSentence: Without the proper sustenance, the man will starve.
uzbekDefinition: Inson, hayvon yoki o'simlikning tirik qolishi uchun zarur bo'lgan taom va suv.
exampleSentenceEn: Without the proper sustenance, the man will starve.
exampleSentenceUz: Kerakli oziq-ovqat bo'lmasa, odam ochlikdan halok bo'ladi.
englishDefinition: Sustenance is food and water needed to keep a person, animal, or plant alive.

definition: When something is tedious, it is long, frustrating, and boring.
exampleSentence: His job involved a lot of tedious typing, filing, and organizing.
uzbekDefinition: Uzoq davom etadigan, asabga tegadigan va zerikarli.
exampleSentenceEn: His job involved a lot of tedious typing, filing, and organizing.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning ishi matn terish, hujjat tikish va tartiblash kabi zerikarli mashg'ulotlardan iborat edi.
englishDefinition: When something is tedious, it is long, frustrating, and boring.

definition: An abbey is a house or group of houses where monks or nuns live.
exampleSentence: When the monk returned to the abbey, he went immediately to his bedroom.
uzbekDefinition: Rohiblar yoki rohibalar yashaydigan bino yoxud binolar majmuasi.
exampleSentenceEn: When the monk returned to the abbey, he went immediately to his bedroom.
exampleSentenceUz: Rohib monastirga qaytishi bilanoq darhol o'z xonasiga kirib ketdi.
englishDefinition: An abbey is a house or group of houses where monks or nuns live.

definition: If something is abundant, then it is available in large quantities.
exampleSentence: Cakes, cookies, and candy were so abundant that the child was very happy.
uzbekDefinition: Katta miqdorda mavjud bo'lgan, yetib ortadigan.
exampleSentenceEn: Cakes, cookies, and candy were so abundant that the child was very happy.
exampleSentenceUz: Tortlar, pechenyelar va shirinliklar shu qadar mo'l ediki, bola juda xursand bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: If something is abundant, then it is available in large quantities.

definition: To adjoin something means to be next to or attached to something else.
exampleSentence: She can listen to her brother's conversations because her room adjoins his.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa bir narsaning yonida joylashgan yoki unga tutash bo'lmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: She can listen to her brother's conversations because her room adjoins his.
exampleSentenceUz: U akasining suhbatlarini eshita oladi, chunki uning xonasi akasining xonasiga tutash.
englishDefinition: To adjoin something means to be next to or attached to something else.

definition: If something is ample, then it is enough or more than enough.
exampleSentence: There was an ample supply of oats to feed the horses.
uzbekDefinition: Kerakli miqdorda yoki undan ham ortiq bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: There was an ample supply of oats to feed the horses.
exampleSentenceUz: Otlarni boqish uchun yetarlicha suli zaxirasi bor edi.
englishDefinition: If something is ample, then it is enough or more than enough.

definition: If a place is arid, then it is hot and dry and gets very little or no rain.
exampleSentence: Not many plants grow in the arid desert.
uzbekDefinition: Juda issiq, quruq va deyarli yomg'ir yog'maydigan joy.
exampleSentenceEn: Not many plants grow in the arid desert.
exampleSentenceUz: Qurg'oqchil cho'lda ko'p o'simlik o'smaydi.
englishDefinition: If a place is arid, then it is hot and dry and gets very little or no rain.

definition: A cathedral is an important and often large and beautifully built church.
exampleSentence: The large cathedral is full of people on Sunday mornings.
uzbekDefinition: Muhim, ko'pincha katta va go'zal qurilgan markaziy cherkov.
exampleSentenceEn: The large cathedral is full of people on Sunday mornings.
exampleSentenceUz: Katta sobor yakshanba kunlari ertalab odamlar bilan to'la bo'ladi.
englishDefinition: A cathedral is an important and often large and beautifully built church.

definition: To deprive someone of something means to not let them have it.
exampleSentence: Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.
uzbekDefinition: Kimnidir biror narsaga ega bo'lish imkoniyatidan ayirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.
exampleSentenceUz: Bola sho'xlik qilgani uchun kechki ovqatdan keyingi shirinlikdan mahrum qilindi.
englishDefinition: To deprive someone of something means to not let them have it.

definition: A drought is a long period of time in which little or no rain falls.
exampleSentence: After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.
uzbekDefinition: Yomg'ir juda kam yog'adigan yoki umuman yog'maydigan uzoq davr.
exampleSentenceEn: After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.
exampleSentenceUz: Uch oylik qurg'oqchilikdan so'ng o't-o'lanlar va daraxtlar quriy boshladi.
englishDefinition: A drought is a long period of time in which little or no rain falls.

definition: If someone is eligible, then they are permitted to do or have something.
exampleSentence: Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani qilishga yoki olishga huquqi bor bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.
exampleSentenceUz: Faqat chipta sotib olganlargina sovrin yutish huquqiga ega edilar.
englishDefinition: If someone is eligible, then they are permitted to do or have something.

definition: To fast means to go without food or drink for a period of time.
exampleSentence: In her religion, they fast for five days and then have a big feast.
uzbekDefinition: Ma'lum bir muddat davomida ovqat va ichimlikdan tiyilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: In her religion, they fast for five days and then have a big feast.
exampleSentenceUz: Ularning dinida besh kun ro'za tutib, so'ngra katta ziyofat uyushtirishadi.
englishDefinition: To fast means to go without food or drink for a period of time.

definition: To grumble means to complain.
exampleSentence: He grumbled about having to work late on Friday.
uzbekDefinition: Past ovozda norozilik bildirib shikoyat qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: He grumbled about having to work late on Friday.
exampleSentenceUz: U juma kuni kechgacha ishlashga majbur bo'lganidan norozi bo'lib to'ng'illadi.
englishDefinition: To grumble means to complain.

definition: If someone goes inland, they travel into the center of a country or land.
exampleSentence: The river curved inland near the campground.
uzbekDefinition: Mamlakat yoki quruqlikning dengizdan uzoq ichki qismi tomon.
exampleSentenceEn: The river curved inland near the campground.
exampleSentenceUz: Daryo lager yaqinida quruqlik ichkarisiga qarab burildi.
englishDefinition: If someone goes inland, they travel into the center of a country or land.

definition: Moisture is small drops of water in the air or on a surface.
exampleSentence: If you breathe on a window, moisture from your breath collects on the glass.
uzbekDefinition: Havoda yoki biror yuza ustida to'planadigan mayda suv tomchilari.
exampleSentenceEn: If you breathe on a window, moisture from your breath collects on the glass.
exampleSentenceUz: Agar oynaga puflasangiz, nafasingizdagi namlik oynada to'planadi.
englishDefinition: Moisture is small drops of water in the air or on a surface.

definition: If something happens nonetheless, then it occurs despite some other thing.
exampleSentence: She tried to keep the dog out of the mud, but it got dirty nonetheless.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa holatlarga qaramasdan sodir bo'ladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: She tried to keep the dog out of the mud, but it got dirty nonetheless.
exampleSentenceUz: U itni loydan uzoq tutishga harakat qildi, ammo it baribir kir bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: If something happens nonetheless, then it occurs despite some other thing.

definition: An oath is a formal, often public, promise.
exampleSentence: Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.
uzbekDefinition: Rasmiy, ko'pincha omma oldida beriladigan va'da.
exampleSentenceEn: Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.
exampleSentenceUz: Sudyalar sudda hammaga adolatli munosabatda bo'lishga qasam ichishlari shart.
englishDefinition: An oath is a formal, often public, promise.

definition: A prairie is a large flat area of grassland.
exampleSentence: The prairie was perfect for a farm because there were hills and trees.
uzbekDefinition: O'tlar bilan qoplangan katta va tekis yaylov hududi.
exampleSentenceEn: The prairie was perfect for a farm because there were hills and trees.
exampleSentenceUz: Bu tekislikda tepaliklar va daraxtlar bo'lgani uchun ferma qurishga juda mos edi.
englishDefinition: A prairie is a large flat area of grassland.

definition: If something is ragged, then it is old, torn, and falling apart.
exampleSentence: They could see his toes through the holes in his ragged shoes.
uzbekDefinition: Eskirgan, yirtilgan va titilib ketgan holatda.
exampleSentenceEn: They could see his toes through the holes in his ragged shoes.
exampleSentenceUz: Yirtiq poyabzalining teshiklaridan uning barmoqlari ko'rinib turardi.
englishDefinition: If something is ragged, then it is old, torn, and falling apart.

definition: If an area of land is rugged, then it is rocky and difficult to travel through.
exampleSentence: Their car couldn't make it far along the rugged roads.
uzbekDefinition: Toshli, baland-past va yurish qiyin bo'lgan yer.
exampleSentenceEn: Their car couldn't make it far along the rugged roads.
exampleSentenceUz: Ularning mashinasi notekis yo'llarda uzoqqa bora olmadi.
englishDefinition: If an area of land is rugged, then it is rocky and difficult to travel through.

definition: If something is scarce, then it is in a very small amount.
exampleSentence: When gasoline was scarce, we rode our bikes, instead of driving, to school.
uzbekDefinition: Juda kam miqdorda mavjud bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: When gasoline was scarce, we rode our bikes, instead of driving, to school.
exampleSentenceUz: Benzin tanqis bo'lganda maktabga mashinada emas, velosipedda borardik.
englishDefinition: If something is scarce, then it is in a very small amount.

definition: To speculate means to guess about something.
exampleSentence: My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.
uzbekDefinition: Yetarli dalil bo'lmasa-da, biror narsa haqida taxmin bildirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.
exampleSentenceUz: Singlim osmonga qarab ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi deb taxmin qildi.
englishDefinition: To speculate means to guess about something.

definition: If something is analytic, it is related to logic and reasoning.
exampleSentence: The analytic article criticized the new plan and presented one of its own.
uzbekDefinition: Mantiq, dalil va chuqur tahlilga asoslangan.
exampleSentenceEn: The analytic article criticized the new plan and presented one of its own.
exampleSentenceUz: Tahliliy maqolada yangi reja tanqid qilindi va o'z muqobil rejasi taqdim etildi.
englishDefinition: If something is analytic, it is related to logic and reasoning.

definition: To assert a fact or belief means to state it with confidence.
exampleSentence: He asserted that his mother's cooking was better than his best friend's.
uzbekDefinition: Biror fikr yoki faktni ishonch bilan aytmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: He asserted that his mother's cooking was better than his best friend's.
exampleSentenceUz: U onasining taomi eng yaqin do'stinikidan mazaliroq ekanini qat'iy ta'kidladi.
englishDefinition: To assert a fact or belief means to state it with confidence.

definition: A bachelor is an unmarried man.
exampleSentence: Since he was a bachelor, Jason did his shopping by himself.
uzbekDefinition: Hali oila qurmagan, uylanmagan erkak kishi.
exampleSentenceEn: Since he was a bachelor, Jason did his shopping by himself.
exampleSentenceUz: Jeyson bo'ydoq bo'lgani uchun bozor-o'charni o'zi qilar edi.
englishDefinition: A bachelor is an unmarried man.

definition: Calculus is an advanced type of mathematics.
exampleSentence: By using calculus, scientists determined small changes in the stars' brightness.
uzbekDefinition: O'zgarishlarni o'rganuvchi oliy matematikaning murakkab bo'limi.
exampleSentenceEn: By using calculus, scientists determined small changes in the stars' brightness.
exampleSentenceUz: Olimlar oliy matematika yordamida yulduzlar yorqinligidagi kichik o'zgarishlarni aniqladilar.
englishDefinition: Calculus is an advanced type of mathematics.

definition: If something is celestial, it is related to the sky or to outer space.
exampleSentence: Comets are celestial objects that are rarely seen.
uzbekDefinition: Osmon yoki koinotga oid bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Comets are celestial objects that are rarely seen.
exampleSentenceUz: Kometalar kamdan-kam ko'rinadigan samoviy jismlardir.
englishDefinition: If something is celestial, it is related to the sky or to outer space.

definition: If something is cognitive, it is related to learning and knowing things.
exampleSentence: After her physical examination, her cognitive strengths were tested.
uzbekDefinition: O'rganish, fikrlash va bilish jarayonlariga tegishli.
exampleSentenceEn: After her physical examination, her cognitive strengths were tested.
exampleSentenceUz: Jismoniy ko'rikdan so'ng uning aqliy qobiliyatlari sinovdan o'tkazildi.
englishDefinition: If something is cognitive, it is related to learning and knowing things.

definition: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.
exampleSentence: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
uzbekDefinition: Ikki narsaning bir-biriga kuch bilan urilishi.
exampleSentenceEn: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
exampleSentenceUz: Ikki mashina o'rtasidagi to'qnashuv qattiq shovqin chiqardi.
englishDefinition: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.

definition: If someone is competent, they are able to think or act successfully.
exampleSentence: Competent employees are much better than unknowledgeable ones.
uzbekDefinition: Biror ishni muvaffaqiyatli va to'g'ri bajara oladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: Competent employees are much better than unknowledgeable ones.
exampleSentenceUz: Malakali xodimlar bilimsiz xodimlardan ancha ustun turadi.
englishDefinition: If someone is competent, they are able to think or act successfully.

definition: A diploma is a certificate proving that someone has completed their studies.
exampleSentence: After four years of college, Mary finally had a diploma.
uzbekDefinition: O'qishni muvaffaqiyatli tugatganligini tasdiqlovchi rasmiy hujjat.
exampleSentenceEn: After four years of college, Mary finally had a diploma.
exampleSentenceUz: To'rt yillik kollejdan so'ng Meri nihoyat diplomga ega bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: A diploma is a certificate proving that someone has completed their studies.

definition: To excel at a subject or activity means to be very good at it.
exampleSentence: Jenny excels at playing the piano.
uzbekDefinition: Biror fan yoki mashg'ulotda juda yuqori natija ko'rsatmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Jenny excels at playing the piano.
exampleSentenceUz: Jenni pianino chalishda juda mahoratli va boshqalardan ustun.
englishDefinition: To excel at a subject or activity means to be very good at it.

definition: Geology is the study of the Earth's natural structures and how they change.
exampleSentence: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
uzbekDefinition: Yerning tabiiy tuzilishi va uning o'zgarishini o'rganuvchi fan.
exampleSentenceEn: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
exampleSentenceUz: U geologiyani o'rgangani uchun tog'lar qanday hosil bo'lganini bilar edi.
englishDefinition: Geology is the study of the Earth's natural structures and how they change.

definition: To harness something means to control and use it, usually to make energy.
exampleSentence: The sails harness the wind in order to move.
uzbekDefinition: Energiya olish yoki foyda ko'rish uchun biror kuchni boshqarib ishlatmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The sails harness the wind in order to move.
exampleSentenceUz: Yelkanlar harakatlanish uchun shamol kuchidan foydalanadi.
englishDefinition: To harness something means to control and use it, usually to make energy.

definition: An intellect is a person's ability to understand things easily.
exampleSentence: She was known for her quick and strong intellect as well as her beauty.
uzbekDefinition: Insonning narsalarni tez tushunish va fikrlash qobiliyati.
exampleSentenceEn: She was known for her quick and strong intellect as well as her beauty.
exampleSentenceUz: U go'zalligi bilan birga o'tkir va kuchli aql-idroki bilan ham mashhur edi.
englishDefinition: An intellect is a person's ability to understand things easily.

definition: If someone is keen, they are intelligent.
exampleSentence: Only the keenest of students could have solved that math problem.
uzbekDefinition: Tez fahmlaydigan, zukko va aqlli.
exampleSentenceEn: Only the keenest of students could have solved that math problem.
exampleSentenceUz: Bu matematika masalasini faqat eng o'tkir zehnli o'quvchilargina yecha olardi.
englishDefinition: If someone is keen, they are intelligent.

definition: Mythology is a group of stories from a particular country or region.
exampleSentence: Egyptian mythology was the basis for a religion.
uzbekDefinition: Ma'lum bir xalq yoki hududga oid qadimiy afsonalar to'plami.
exampleSentenceEn: Egyptian mythology was the basis for a religion.
exampleSentenceUz: Qadimgi Misr mifologiyasi ularning diniga asos bo'lgan edi.
englishDefinition: Mythology is a group of stories from a particular country or region.

definition: Physiology is the study of the various parts of living things.
exampleSentence: His work in physiology helped him understand how the human body works.
uzbekDefinition: Tirik organizmlarning a'zolari va faoliyatini o'rganuvchi fan.
exampleSentenceEn: His work in physiology helped him understand how the human body works.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning fiziologiya sohasidagi ishi inson tanasi qanday ishlashini tushunishga yordam berdi.
englishDefinition: Physiology is the study of the various parts of living things.

definition: If something is radioactive, then it lets out, or is related to, radiation.
exampleSentence: Radioactive materials can be very bad for anyone's health.
uzbekDefinition: O'zidan zararli nurlanish tarqatadigan yoki radiatsiyaga oid.
exampleSentenceEn: Radioactive materials can be very bad for anyone's health.
exampleSentenceUz: Radioaktiv moddalar har qanday inson salomatligi uchun juda xavfli bo'lishi mumkin.
englishDefinition: If something is radioactive, then it lets out, or is related to, radiation.

definition: Relativity is a set of ideas about time and space developed by Albert Einstein.
exampleSentence: Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed in the universe.
uzbekDefinition: Albert Eynshteyn yaratgan vaqt va makon haqidagi nazariya.
exampleSentenceEn: Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed in the universe.
exampleSentenceUz: Nisbiylik nazariyasi yorug'lik koinotda bir xil tezlikda tarqalishini o'rgatadi.
englishDefinition: Relativity is a set of ideas about time and space developed by Albert Einstein.

definition: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.
exampleSentence: Sociology teaches that people's problems are a result of their society.
uzbekDefinition: Insoniyat jamiyati, uning tuzilishi va muammolarini o'rganuvchi fan.
exampleSentenceEn: Sociology teaches that people's problems are a result of their society.
exampleSentenceUz: Sotsiologiya insonlar muammolari ularning jamiyati natijasi ekanini o'rgatadi.
englishDefinition: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.

definition: If something is theoretical, it is based on theory rather than experience.
exampleSentence: His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.
uzbekDefinition: Amaliy tajribaga emas, nazariyaga asoslangan.
exampleSentenceEn: His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning xulosasi faqat nazariy bo'lib, omma oldida e'lon qilish uchun emas edi.
englishDefinition: If something is theoretical, it is based on theory rather than experience.

definition: An administrator is a person who controls a business, company, or organization.
exampleSentence: Everyone in the store did whatever the administrator asked them to do.
uzbekDefinition: Kompaniya, do'kon yoki tashkilotni boshqaradigan mas'ul shaxs.
exampleSentenceEn: Everyone in the store did whatever the administrator asked them to do.
exampleSentenceUz: Do'kondagi hamma boshqaruvchi nima desa shuni bajarar edi.
englishDefinition: An administrator is a person who controls a business, company, or organization.

definition: If someone is affluent, they are wealthy.
exampleSentence: People in the city are usually more affluent than people in the country.
uzbekDefinition: Moddiy jihatdan farovon va boy yashaydigan.
exampleSentenceEn: People in the city are usually more affluent than people in the country.
exampleSentenceUz: Shahar aholisi odatda qishloq aholisiga qaraganda badavlatroq bo'ladi.
englishDefinition: If someone is affluent, they are wealthy.

definition: To audit means to inspect financial records from a person or business.
exampleSentence: The government usually audits companies that report lower than usual incomes.
uzbekDefinition: Shaxs yoki kompaniyaning moliyaviy hujjatlarini tekshirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The government usually audits companies that report lower than usual incomes.
exampleSentenceUz: Hukumat odatda daromadini odatdagidan kam ko'rsatgan kompaniyalarni taftish qiladi.
englishDefinition: To audit means to inspect financial records from a person or business.

definition: To automate a company means to install machines or computers to do the work.
exampleSentence: When the bank automated, it started installing ATM machines.
uzbekDefinition: Ishni bajarish uchun mashina yoki kompyuterlarni joriy qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: When the bank automated, it started installing ATM machines.
exampleSentenceUz: Bank avtomatlashtirilgach, bankomatlar o'rnatila boshlandi.
englishDefinition: To automate a company means to install machines or computers to do the work.

definition: To bribe someone means to illegally persuade them for a favor with money.
exampleSentence: The judge was bribed so that she would set the suspect free.
uzbekDefinition: Noqonuniy tarzda pul evaziga kimnidir o'z foydasiga og'dirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The judge was bribed so that she would set the suspect free.
exampleSentenceUz: Gumonlanuvchini ozod qilishlari uchun sudyaga pora berilgan edi.
englishDefinition: To bribe someone means to illegally persuade them for a favor with money.

definition: If someone is corrupt, they break the law for money or fame.
exampleSentence: The corrupt policemen didn't arrest the man because he gave them money.
uzbekDefinition: Pul yoki shon-shuhrat uchun qonunni buzadigan.
exampleSentenceEn: The corrupt policemen didn't arrest the man because he gave them money.
exampleSentenceUz: Poraxo'r politsiyachilar erkak ularga pul bergani uchun uni hibsga olishmadi.
englishDefinition: If someone is corrupt, they break the law for money or fame.

definition: To dispose of something means to get rid of it.
exampleSentence: He disposed of the can by throwing it into the recycle bin.
uzbekDefinition: Keraksiz narsadan qutulmoq yoki uni chiqindiga tashlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: He disposed of the can by throwing it into the recycle bin.
exampleSentenceUz: U konserva idishini qayta ishlash qutisiga tashlab yubordi.
englishDefinition: To dispose of something means to get rid of it.

definition: A headquarters is a building where the bosses of a company work.
exampleSentence: He drove the long route to headquarters because it was a nice day.
uzbekDefinition: Kompaniya rahbarlari ishlaydigan markaziy bino.
exampleSentenceEn: He drove the long route to headquarters because it was a nice day.
exampleSentenceUz: Ob-havo yaxshi bo'lgani uchun u bosh qarorgohga uzoqroq yo'l bilan mashina haydab bordi.
englishDefinition: A headquarters is a building where the bosses of a company work.

definition: An incentive is what makes a person want to do something.
exampleSentence: The chance of winning a prize was incentive to get people to play the game.
uzbekDefinition: Insonni biror ish qilishga undaydigan sabab yoki mukofot.
exampleSentenceEn: The chance of winning a prize was incentive to get people to play the game.
exampleSentenceUz: Sovrin yutib olish imkoniyati odamlarni o'yin o'ynashga undovchi rag'bat edi.
englishDefinition: An incentive is what makes a person want to do something.

definition: An infrastructure is a collection of services needed to run a society or business.
exampleSentence: Power lines are important parts of a city's infrastructure.
uzbekDefinition: Jamiyat yoki biznes ishlashi uchun zarur bo'lgan asosiy tizimlar majmui.
exampleSentenceEn: Power lines are important parts of a city's infrastructure.
exampleSentenceUz: Elektr tarmoqlari shahar infratuzilmasining muhim qismidir.
englishDefinition: An infrastructure is a collection of services needed to run a society or business.

definition: To legislate means to make laws.
exampleSentence: Senators have to legislate fairly, so most people will enjoy the benefits.
uzbekDefinition: Rasmiy qonunlar ishlab chiqmoq va qabul qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Senators have to legislate fairly, so most people will enjoy the benefits.
exampleSentenceUz: Senatorlar ko'pchilik foyda ko'rishi uchun adolatli qonunlar chiqarishlari kerak.
englishDefinition: To legislate means to make laws.

definition: If something is legitimate, then it is acceptable according to the law.
exampleSentence: She found a legitimate plan to raise extra funds for her vacation.
uzbekDefinition: Qonunga muvofiq va maqbul bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: She found a legitimate plan to raise extra funds for her vacation.
exampleSentenceUz: U ta'til uchun qo'shimcha pul topishning qonuniy rejasini topdi.
englishDefinition: If something is legitimate, then it is acceptable according to the law.

definition: To manipulate something means to skillfully or unfairly control or affect it.
exampleSentence: The Dr. manipulated the data to make it look like the cure was working.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani o'z foydasiga ustalik yoki nohaqlik bilan o'zgartirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The Dr. manipulated the data to make it look like the cure was working.
exampleSentenceUz: Shifokor dori ishlayotgandek ko'rsatish uchun ma'lumotlarni soxtalashtirdi.
englishDefinition: To manipulate something means to skillfully or unfairly control or affect it.

definition: Merchandise is goods ready to be purchased or sold.
exampleSentence: The store added more merchandise because there were more shoppers.
uzbekDefinition: Sotishga tayyorlab qo'yilgan mahsulotlar.
exampleSentenceEn: The store added more merchandise because there were more shoppers.
exampleSentenceUz: Xaridorlar ko'paygani sababli do'kon ko'proq tovar olib keldi.
englishDefinition: Merchandise is goods ready to be purchased or sold.

definition: Retail is the activity of selling goods to the public, often for personal use.
exampleSentence: Though cheap to make, once a t-shirt reaches retail, it costs ten times as much.
uzbekDefinition: Tovarlarni bevosita iste'molchilarga sotish faoliyati.
exampleSentenceEn: Though cheap to make, once a t-shirt reaches retail, it costs ten times as much.
exampleSentenceUz: Ishlab chiqarish arzon bo'lsa-da, futbolka chakana savdoga chiqqach o'n baravar qimmatlashadi.
englishDefinition: Retail is the activity of selling goods to the public, often for personal use.

definition: Revenue is the income made by a company.
exampleSentence: The new products really increased the business's monthly revenue.
uzbekDefinition: Kompaniya yoki davlat tomonidan olinadigan umumiy daromad.
exampleSentenceEn: The new products really increased the business's monthly revenue.
exampleSentenceUz: Yangi mahsulotlar biznesning oylik daromadini haqiqatan ham oshirdi.
englishDefinition: Revenue is the income made by a company.

definition: Rubbish is trash or waste.
exampleSentence: The floor around the garbage can was covered with all kinds of rubbish.
uzbekDefinition: Keraksiz narsalar va chiqindilar.
exampleSentenceEn: The floor around the garbage can was covered with all kinds of rubbish.
exampleSentenceUz: Chiqindi qutisi atrofidagi pol har xil axlatlar bilan to'lib ketgan edi.
englishDefinition: Rubbish is trash or waste.

definition: A subsidy is money given by the government to companies to assist them.
exampleSentence: The official gave the company a subsidy, so it could open two new factories.
uzbekDefinition: Davlat tomonidan kompaniyalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun beriladigan mablag'.
exampleSentenceEn: The official gave the company a subsidy, so it could open two new factories.
exampleSentenceUz: Amaldor ikkita yangi zavod ochishi uchun kompaniyaga subsidiya ajratdi.
englishDefinition: A subsidy is money given by the government to companies to assist them.

definition: A transaction is an act of buying or selling something.
exampleSentence: Because the clerk was new at the job, the simple transaction took a long time.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani sotib olish yoki sotish jarayoni.
exampleSentenceEn: Because the clerk was new at the job, the simple transaction took a long time.
exampleSentenceUz: Sotuvchi ishga yangi kelgani uchun oddiy savdo amaliyoti uzoq vaqt oldi.
englishDefinition: A transaction is an act of buying or selling something.

definition: To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.
exampleSentence: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated the speed limit.
uzbekDefinition: Qonun, qoida yoki kelishuvga amal qilmay uni buzmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated the speed limit.
exampleSentenceUz: Politsiyachi tezlik chegarasini buzganimni aytib, menga jarima qog'ozi yozdi.
englishDefinition: To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.

definition: To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.
exampleSentence: She assessed the condition of the toy car before buying it.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsaning tuzilishi, maqsadi yoki sifatini aniqlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: She assessed the condition of the toy car before buying it.
exampleSentenceUz: U o'yinchoq mashinani sotib olishdan oldin uning holatini baholadi.
englishDefinition: To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.

definition: To astonish someone means to greatly surprise them.
exampleSentence: The amount of people that came to her party astonished her.
uzbekDefinition: Kimnidir nihoyatda katta ajablanishga solmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The amount of people that came to her party astonished her.
exampleSentenceUz: Bazmiga kelgan odamlarning soni uni hayratda qoldirdi.
englishDefinition: To astonish someone means to greatly surprise them.

definition: To commence something means to begin it.
exampleSentence: His speech commenced with a "thank you" to all who had helped him succeed.
uzbekDefinition: Biror ish yoki tadbirni boshlab yubormoq.
exampleSentenceEn: His speech commenced with a "thank you" to all who had helped him succeed.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning nutqi yordam bergan barchaga rahmat aytish bilan boshlandi.
englishDefinition: To commence something means to begin it.

definition: The essence of something is its important qualities or basic characteristics.
exampleSentence: The essence of the argument was that both sides felt they had lost money.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsaning eng muhim xususiyatlari va asosiy mazmuni.
exampleSentenceEn: The essence of the argument was that both sides felt they had lost money.
exampleSentenceUz: Bahsning mohiyati shunda ediki, har ikki tomon ham pul yo'qotganini his qildi.
englishDefinition: The essence of something is its important qualities or basic characteristics.

definition: To extract something means to remove it.
exampleSentence: The dentist extracted the woman's damaged tooth and put in a fake one.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani kuch bilan yoki maxsus usulda chiqarib olmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The dentist extracted the woman's damaged tooth and put in a fake one.
exampleSentenceUz: Tish shifokori ayolning kasallangan tishini sug'urib olib, o'rniga sun'iy tish qo'ydi.
englishDefinition: To extract something means to remove it.

definition: If something is fabulous, it is extremely good.
exampleSentence: This strawberry is the best I've ever had. It's fabulous.
uzbekDefinition: Nihoyatda yaxshi, zo'r va hayratlanarli.
exampleSentenceEn: This strawberry is the best I've ever had. It's fabulous.
exampleSentenceUz: Bu qulupnay men yeganlarning eng zo'ri. U juda ajoyib.
englishDefinition: If something is fabulous, it is extremely good.

definition: Haste is speed in movement or action.
exampleSentence: In order to get to the meeting in time, he proceeds with haste.
uzbekDefinition: Harakat yoki ishda tezlik, shoshqaloqlik.
exampleSentenceEn: In order to get to the meeting in time, he proceeds with haste.
exampleSentenceUz: Uchrashuvga o'z vaqtida yetib borish uchun u shoshilib harakat qiladi.
englishDefinition: Haste is speed in movement or action.

definition: An impulse is a sudden thoughtless urge to do something.
exampleSentence: Because of the scary noise, she had an impulse to run somewhere and hide.
uzbekDefinition: O'ylamasdan birdaniga biror ish qilishga bo'lgan kuchli istak.
exampleSentenceEn: Because of the scary noise, she had an impulse to run somewhere and hide.
exampleSentenceUz: Qo'rqinchli shovqin tufayli unda biror joyga yugurib yashirinish istagi paydo bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: An impulse is a sudden thoughtless urge to do something.

definition: Latter describes something last in a series or the second choice of two things.
exampleSentence: In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.
uzbekDefinition: Ketma-ketlikdagi oxirgi yoki ikki variantdan ikkinchisi.
exampleSentenceEn: In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.
exampleSentenceUz: O'yinning so'nggi daqiqalarida mehmon jamoa g'alaba golini kiritdi.
englishDefinition: Latter describes something last in a series or the second choice of two things.

definition: A molecule is the smallest basic unit that makes up a physical substance.
exampleSentence: A tiny drop of water is made up of thousands of molecules of water.
uzbekDefinition: Moddaning xossalarini saqlovchi eng kichik zarracha.
exampleSentenceEn: A tiny drop of water is made up of thousands of molecules of water.
exampleSentenceUz: Bir tomchi suv minglab suv molekulalaridan tashkil topgan.
englishDefinition: A molecule is the smallest basic unit that makes up a physical substance.

definition: If something is ongoing, then it is still happening or still growing.
exampleSentence: The development of plants is ongoing because it takes time for them to mature.
uzbekDefinition: Hali ham sodir bo'layotgan yoki rivojlanishda davom etayotgan.
exampleSentenceEn: The development of plants is ongoing because it takes time for them to mature.
exampleSentenceUz: O'simliklarning rivojlanishi davomiy jarayon, chunki ularning yetilishi vaqt oladi.
englishDefinition: If something is ongoing, then it is still happening or still growing.

definition: If something is pharmaceutical, then it is related to the development of drugs.
exampleSentence: Pharmaceutical companies discover new cures to illnesses all the time.
uzbekDefinition: Dori-darmonlar ishlab chiqarish va yaratishga tegishli.
exampleSentenceEn: Pharmaceutical companies discover new cures to illnesses all the time.
exampleSentenceUz: Farmatsevtika kompaniyalari doimo kasalliklarga qarshi yangi dorilar kashf etadi.
englishDefinition: If something is pharmaceutical, then it is related to the development of drugs.

definition: If someone is precise, then they are exact and careful about their work.
exampleSentence: The builder was very precise about where he placed the nails.
uzbekDefinition: Ishda juda aniq, to'g'ri va ehtiyotkor.
exampleSentenceEn: The builder was very precise about where he placed the nails.
exampleSentenceUz: Usta mixlarni qayerga qoqishda juda aniq va puxta edi.
englishDefinition: If someone is precise, then they are exact and careful about their work.

definition: Proximity is closeness in time, space, or relationships.
exampleSentence: All the trees in the proximity of the beach had been cut down.
uzbekDefinition: Vaqt, masofa yoki munosabat jihatidan yaqin bo'lish.
exampleSentenceEn: All the trees in the proximity of the beach had been cut down.
exampleSentenceUz: Sohil yaqinidagi barcha daraxtlar kesib tashlangan edi.
englishDefinition: Proximity is closeness in time, space, or relationships.

definition: Publicity is public attention given to someone or something by the media.
exampleSentence: She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.
uzbekDefinition: Ommaviy axborot vositalari orqali kimdir yoki biror narsaga beriladigan e'tibor.
exampleSentenceEn: She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.
exampleSentenceUz: Filmdagi ijrosidan keyin u katta shuhrat va e'tiborga sazovor bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: Publicity is public attention given to someone or something by the media.

definition: A remedy is a cure for a disease, argument, or problem.
exampleSentence: A good remedy for a headache is an aspirin and a glass of water.
uzbekDefinition: Kasallik, nizo yoki muammoni hal qiluvchi vosita.
exampleSentenceEn: A good remedy for a headache is an aspirin and a glass of water.
exampleSentenceUz: Bosh og'rig'iga yaxshi davo — aspirin va bir stakan suvdir.
englishDefinition: A remedy is a cure for a disease, argument, or problem.

definition: The significance of something is the quality that makes it important.
exampleSentence: The significance of the snowy weather was that we didn't have to go to school.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani muhim qiladigan xususiyat yoki qiymat.
exampleSentenceEn: The significance of the snowy weather was that we didn't have to go to school.
exampleSentenceUz: Qorli ob-havoning ahamiyati shunda ediki, biz maktabga borishimiz shart emas edi.
englishDefinition: The significance of something is the quality that makes it important.

definition: If something is subsequent, then it comes after something else in time.
exampleSentence: The flood and the subsequent rescue of those caught in the flood were on TV.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa bir voqeadan keyin sodir bo'ladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: The flood and the subsequent rescue of those caught in the flood were on TV.
exampleSentenceUz: Toshqin va undan keyingi odamlarni qutqarish ishlari televizorda ko'rsatildi.
englishDefinition: If something is subsequent, then it comes after something else in time.

definition: If something is synthetic, then it is made to be like something natural.
exampleSentence: Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.
uzbekDefinition: Tabiiy narsaga o'xshatib sun'iy yo'l bilan yaratilgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.
exampleSentenceUz: Sintetik matolardan tikilgan kiyimlar odamni issiq saqlashda juda samarali.
englishDefinition: If something is synthetic, then it is made to be like something natural.

definition: If something is terminal, then it causes or results in death.
exampleSentence: Since his condition was not terminal, he felt a great sense of relief.
uzbekDefinition: O'lim bilan yakunlanadigan yoki halokatli.
exampleSentenceEn: Since his condition was not terminal, he felt a great sense of relief.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning kasalligi o'limga olib boruvchi emasligi sababli u katta yengillik his qildi.
englishDefinition: If something is terminal, then it causes or results in death.

definition: The altitude of a place is its height above sea level.
exampleSentence: The air was thin at such a high altitude on the mountain.
uzbekDefinition: Biror joyning dengiz sathidan balandligi.
exampleSentenceEn: The air was thin at such a high altitude on the mountain.
exampleSentenceUz: Tog'ning bunday yuqori balandligida havo siyrak edi.
englishDefinition: The altitude of a place is its height above sea level.

definition: A coastline is the outline of a country's coast.
exampleSentence: He noticed that most of the cities in Australia are on the coastline.
uzbekDefinition: Mamlakat yoki quruqlik qirg'og'ining tashqi chizig'i.
exampleSentenceEn: He noticed that most of the cities in Australia are on the coastline.
exampleSentenceUz: U Avstraliyadagi aksariyat shaharlar sohil chizig'ida joylashganini payqadi.
englishDefinition: A coastline is the outline of a country's coast.

definition: To deter means to prevent or discourage someone from doing something.
exampleSentence: Icy roads deter people from driving their cars.
uzbekDefinition: Kimnidir biror ish qilishdan qaytarib qo'ymoq yoki chalg'itmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Icy roads deter people from driving their cars.
exampleSentenceUz: Muzlagan yo'llar odamlarni mashina haydashdan to'xtatib qoladi.
englishDefinition: To deter means to prevent or discourage someone from doing something.

definition: To devise something means to have an idea or plan about it in the mind.
exampleSentence: The thieves devised a plan to steal the diamonds.
uzbekDefinition: Aql bilan yangi g'oya yoki reja tuzmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The thieves devised a plan to steal the diamonds.
exampleSentenceUz: O'g'rilar olmoslarni o'g'irlash rejasini o'ylab topdilar.
englishDefinition: To devise something means to have an idea or plan about it in the mind.

definition: Expertise is the knowledge and skills to do something well.
exampleSentence: John has a lot of advertising expertise. He can sell anything!
uzbekDefinition: Biror ishni yaxshi bajarish uchun zarur bo'lgan chuqur bilim va ko'nikma.
exampleSentenceEn: John has a lot of advertising expertise. He can sell anything!
exampleSentenceUz: Jon reklama sohasida katta mahoratga ega. U har qanday narsani sota oladi!
englishDefinition: Expertise is the knowledge and skills to do something well.

definition: A fracture is a crack or break in something.
exampleSentence: Don't stand on that leg because there is a fracture. It might get worse.
uzbekDefinition: Suyak yoki qattiq jismdagi yoriq yoxud sinish.
exampleSentenceEn: Don't stand on that leg because there is a fracture. It might get worse.
exampleSentenceUz: Bu oyog'ingga bosma, chunki unda yoriq bor. Yomonlashib ketishi mumkin.
englishDefinition: A fracture is a crack or break in something.

definition: To impair something means to damage it or make it worse.
exampleSentence: Drinking coffee impairs my ability to go to sleep.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsaga zarar yetkazmoq yoki sifatini pasaytirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Drinking coffee impairs my ability to go to sleep.
exampleSentenceUz: Qahva ichish mening uxlash qobiliyatimni yomonlashtiradi.
englishDefinition: To impair something means to damage it or make it worse.

definition: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.
exampleSentence: The school decided to implement a new teaching strategy.
uzbekDefinition: Rejalashtirilgan ishning bajarilishini ta'minlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The school decided to implement a new teaching strategy.
exampleSentenceUz: Maktab yangi o'qitish strategiyasini joriy qilishga qaror qildi.
englishDefinition: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

definition: If something is indigenous, it is originally from, or native to, a place.
exampleSentence: Tomatoes are indigenous to the Americas.
uzbekDefinition: Asli ma'lum bir joydan kelib chiqqan yoki o'sha yerga xos bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Tomatoes are indigenous to the Americas.
exampleSentenceUz: Pomidor asli Amerika qit'asiga xos mahalliy o'simlikdir.
englishDefinition: If something is indigenous, it is originally from, or native to, a place.

definition: Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.
exampleSentence: The physics textbook gave the student new insight about gravity.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsa haqidagi chuqur va aniq tushuncha.
exampleSentenceEn: The physics textbook gave the student new insight about gravity.
exampleSentenceUz: Fizika darsligi o'quvchiga tortishish kuchi haqida yangi tushuncha berdi.
englishDefinition: Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.

definition: A limb is a large branch on a tree.
exampleSentence: The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.
uzbekDefinition: Daraxtning katta shoxi (yoki qo'l-oyoq).
exampleSentenceEn: The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.
exampleSentenceUz: Maymun daraxt shoxida o'tirib, meva yeb rohatlanardi.
englishDefinition: A limb is a large branch on a tree.

definition: A migraine is a painful headache that makes one feel sick.
exampleSentence: My sister gets a migraine every time she has a lot of stress.
uzbekDefinition: Ko'ngil aynishini keltirib chiqaradigan juda kuchli bosh og'rig'i.
exampleSentenceEn: My sister gets a migraine every time she has a lot of stress.
exampleSentenceUz: Singlim har gal qattiq stressga tushganda migren bilan og'riydi.
englishDefinition: A migraine is a painful headache that makes one feel sick.

definition: Optimism is the feeling of being hopeful about the future or success of something.
exampleSentence: The mother had optimism about her children's futures.
uzbekDefinition: Kelajak yoki biror ishning muvaffaqiyatiga bo'lgan umidvor tuyg'u.
exampleSentenceEn: The mother had optimism about her children's futures.
exampleSentenceUz: Ona farzandlarining kelajagiga nekbinlik bilan qarar edi.
englishDefinition: Optimism is the feeling of being hopeful about the future or success of something.

definition: When something is peculiar, it is strange, sometimes in a bad way.
exampleSentence: That peculiar smell coming from the kitchen reminds me of rotten eggs.
uzbekDefinition: G'ayrioddiy, ba'zan yoqimsiz tarzda g'alati.
exampleSentenceEn: That peculiar smell coming from the kitchen reminds me of rotten eggs.
exampleSentenceUz: Oshxonadan kelayotgan o'sha g'alati hid chirigan tuxumni eslatadi.
englishDefinition: When something is peculiar, it is strange, sometimes in a bad way.

definition: When a person is proficient at something, they can do it well.
exampleSentence: Secretaries are proficient at typing quickly.
uzbekDefinition: Biror ishni yaxshi va tez bajara oladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: Secretaries are proficient at typing quickly.
exampleSentenceUz: Kotibalar tez matn terishda juda mahoratlidirlar.
englishDefinition: When a person is proficient at something, they can do it well.

definition: A quest is a long and difficult search for something.
exampleSentence: The treasure hunter went on a quest to find an ancient gold necklace.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani topish uchun qilingan uzoq va qiyin qidiruv.
exampleSentenceEn: The treasure hunter went on a quest to find an ancient gold necklace.
exampleSentenceUz: Xazina izlovchi qadimiy oltin marjonni topish uchun safarga chiqdi.
englishDefinition: A quest is a long and difficult search for something.

definition: A ridge is a long, narrow piece of raised land.
exampleSentence: The brown bear walked along the edge of the mountain ridge.
uzbekDefinition: Balandlashgan yerning uzun va tor chizig'i, tog' qirrasi.
exampleSentenceEn: The brown bear walked along the edge of the mountain ridge.
exampleSentenceUz: Qo'ng'ir ayiq tog' tizmasining cheti bo'ylab yurib ketdi.
englishDefinition: A ridge is a long, narrow piece of raised land.

definition: A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.
exampleSentence: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.
uzbekDefinition: Inson turmush qurgan shaxs (er yoki xotin).
exampleSentenceEn: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.
exampleSentenceUz: Men turmush o'rtog'im va ikki farzandim bilan bir uyda yashayman.
englishDefinition: A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.

definition: To thrust means to push or move something quickly with a lot of force.
exampleSentence: The boxer thrust his fist into the punching bag.
uzbekDefinition: Katta kuch bilan tez harakatlantirmoq yoki zarba bermoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The boxer thrust his fist into the punching bag.
exampleSentenceUz: Bokschi mushtini boks qopiga kuch bilan urdi.
englishDefinition: To thrust means to push or move something quickly with a lot of force.

definition: To tolerate something means to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant.
exampleSentence: When you are in a hurry, it can be hard to tolerate traffic signals.
uzbekDefinition: Yoqimsiz bo'lsa-da, biror narsaga sabr bilan chiday olmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: When you are in a hurry, it can be hard to tolerate traffic signals.
exampleSentenceUz: Shoshilib turganingizda svetoforlarga toqat qilish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
englishDefinition: To tolerate something means to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant.

definition: If a plant or animal is aquatic, it lives or grows in water.
exampleSentence: The dolphin is an aquatic mammal.
uzbekDefinition: Suvda yashaydigan yoki o'sadigan o'simlik yoxud hayvon.
exampleSentenceEn: The dolphin is an aquatic mammal.
exampleSentenceUz: Delfin — suvda yashovchi sutemizuvchi hayvon.
englishDefinition: If a plant or animal is aquatic, it lives or grows in water.

definition: The biosphere is the earth's surface and atmosphere where there are living things.
exampleSentence: Birds, trees, and worms all thrive in the biosphere.
uzbekDefinition: Yer yuzasi va atmosferaning tirik organizmlar yashaydigan qismi.
exampleSentenceEn: Birds, trees, and worms all thrive in the biosphere.
exampleSentenceUz: Qushlar, daraxtlar va chuvalchanglarning barchasi biosferada rivojlanadi.
englishDefinition: The biosphere is the earth's surface and atmosphere where there are living things.

definition: When something is bizarre, it is very strange.
exampleSentence: My bizarre dreams make no sense to me when I am awake.
uzbekDefinition: Juda g'alati va tushunarsiz.
exampleSentenceEn: My bizarre dreams make no sense to me when I am awake.
exampleSentenceUz: Uyg'onganimda mening g'alati tushlarimda hech qanday ma'no qolmaydi.
englishDefinition: When something is bizarre, it is very strange.

definition: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature.
exampleSentence: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
uzbekDefinition: Haroratni o'lchash shkalasi.
exampleSentenceEn: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
exampleSentenceUz: Suv nol daraja Selsiyda muzlaydi.
englishDefinition: Celsius is a scale for measuring temperature.

definition: If something is coarse, that means it has a rough texture.
exampleSentence: The coarse sweater made my skin itch.

exampleSentenceUz: U yaxshi ishladim deb hisoblaydi va boshlig'i ham shunga yarasha haq to'lashi kerak.
englishDefinition: If someone acts accordingly, they act in a way that is suitable.

exampleSentenceEn: When the ship reached its destination, the crew dropped the anchor.

englishDefinition: An anchor is a heavy object dropped from a boat to make it stay in one place.

definition: A buoy is a floating sign that warns boats of dangerous areas.

definition: Context is the situations that form the background of an event.

englishDefinition: To offset means to use one thing to cancel out the effect of another thing.
