definition: A sibling is a brother or sister.
exampleSentence: Jane has two siblings, an older brother and a younger sister.
uzbekDefinition: Bir ota-onadan tug'ilgan aka, uka, opa yoki singil.
exampleSentenceEn: Jane has two siblings, an older brother and a younger sister.
exampleSentenceUz: Jeynning ikki nafar tug'ishgani — bitta akasi va bitta singlisi bor.
englishDefinition: A sibling is a brother or sister.

definition: If someone is skinny, they are extremely thin.
exampleSentence: Polly is very skinny. I think she needs to eat more.
uzbekDefinition: Haddan tashqari ozg'in va nozik tana tuzilishiga ega.
exampleSentenceEn: Polly is very skinny. I think she needs to eat more.
exampleSentenceUz: Polli juda ozg'in. Menimcha, u ko'proq ovqat yeyishi kerak.
englishDefinition: If someone is skinny, they are extremely thin.

definition: If something is vague, it is not clear, and it gives very few details.
exampleSentence: I asked him about his mother's health, but he was very vague about it.
uzbekDefinition: Aniq tafsilotlarni bermaydigan, tushunarsiz yoki mujmal.
exampleSentenceEn: I asked him about his mother's health, but he was very vague about it.
exampleSentenceUz: Men undan onasining sog'lig'i haqida so'radim, lekin u bu haqda juda noaniq javob berdi.
englishDefinition: If something is vague, it is not clear, and it gives very few details.

definition: An acid is a chemical that can burn or dissolve other substances.
exampleSentence: In chemistry class, we mixed two acids together and watched the reaction.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa moddalarni kuydirishi yoki eritishi mumkin bo'lgan kimyoviy modda.
exampleSentenceEn: In chemistry class, we mixed two acids together and watched the reaction.
exampleSentenceUz: Kimyo darsida biz ikkita kislotani aralashtirib, reaksiyani kuzatdik.
englishDefinition: An acid is a chemical that can burn or dissolve other substances.

definition: An administration is the group of people who manage a company or organization.
exampleSentence: She hoped she could be promoted to a job in the administration.
uzbekDefinition: Kompaniya yoki tashkilotni boshqaradigan rahbarlar guruhi.
exampleSentenceEn: She hoped she could be promoted to a job in the administration.
exampleSentenceUz: U ma'muriyatdagi lavozimga ko'tarilishga umid qilardi.
englishDefinition: An administration is the group of people who manage a company or organization.

definition: Administrative describes anything related to managing a company or organization.
exampleSentence: I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.
uzbekDefinition: Kompaniya yoki tashkilotni boshqarish bilan bog'liq bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.
exampleSentenceUz: Men kompaniya egasining ma'muriy yordamchisi bo'lib ishlayman.
englishDefinition: Administrative describes anything related to managing a company or organization.

definition: Biotechnology is the use of living parts, such as cells, in industry and technology.
exampleSentence: Researchers at the biotechnology company use bacteria to make medicine.
uzbekDefinition: Hujayra kabi tirik organizm qismlaridan sanoat va texnologiyada foydalanish sohasi.
exampleSentenceEn: Researchers at the biotechnology company use bacteria to make medicine.
exampleSentenceUz: Biotexnologiya kompaniyasi tadqiqotchilari dori tayyorlash uchun bakteriyalardan foydalanadilar.
englishDefinition: Biotechnology is the use of living parts, such as cells, in industry and technology.

definition: Cholesterol is a substance in fat, tissues, and blood of all animals.
exampleSentence: When people have too much cholesterol, they are at a high risk for heart problems.
uzbekDefinition: Barcha hayvonlarning yog', to'qima va qonida uchraydigan modda.
exampleSentenceEn: When people have too much cholesterol, they are at a high risk for heart problems.
exampleSentenceUz: Odamlar organizmida xolesterin ko'payib ketganda, yurak kasalliklariga chalinish xavfi ortadi.
englishDefinition: Cholesterol is a substance in fat, tissues, and blood of all animals.

definition: A coalition is a group of people or organizations working for a common purpose.
exampleSentence: The companies formed a coalition to make trade less expensive.
uzbekDefinition: Umumiy maqsad yo'lida birgalikda ishlaydigan odamlar yoki tashkilotlar guruhi.
exampleSentenceEn: The companies formed a coalition to make trade less expensive.
exampleSentenceUz: Kompaniyalar savdoni arzonlashtirish maqsadida birlashma tuzishdi.
englishDefinition: A coalition is a group of people or organizations working for a common purpose.

definition: When something is deceptive, it encourages one to believe something that is false.
exampleSentence: The scary-looking man's appearance is deceptive, but he is actually very nice.
uzbekDefinition: Haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan narsaga ishontiradigan yoki chalg'itadigan.
exampleSentenceEn: The scary-looking man's appearance is deceptive, but he is actually very nice.
exampleSentenceUz: Qo'rqinchli ko'rinadigan bu odamning tashqi ko'rinishi aldamchi, aslida u juda mehribon.
englishDefinition: When something is deceptive, it encourages one to believe something that is false.

definition: Diabetes is a medical condition where a person has too much sugar in their blood.
exampleSentence: Overweight people are more likely to suffer from diabetes than slimmer ones.
uzbekDefinition: Qonda shakar miqdori me'yordan ortib ketishi bilan kechadigan tibbiy kasallik.
exampleSentenceEn: Overweight people are more likely to suffer from diabetes than slimmer ones.
exampleSentenceUz: Ortiqcha vaznli odamlar ozg'in odamlarga qaraganda qandli diabetga ko'proq chalinishadi.
englishDefinition: Diabetes is a medical condition where a person has too much sugar in their blood.

definition: To eliminate something that is unwanted means to completely remove it.
exampleSentence: Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
uzbekDefinition: Keraksiz yoki istalmagan narsani butunlay olib tashlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
exampleSentenceUz: Xavfsizlik kamarini taqish mashina haydashdagi ayrim xavflarni bartaraf etadi.
englishDefinition: To eliminate something that is unwanted means to completely remove it.

definition: Erosion is the destruction of rock or soil due to flowing water or weather.
exampleSentence: Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
uzbekDefinition: Oqar suv yoki ob-havo ta'sirida tosh va tuproqning yemirilishi.
exampleSentenceEn: Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
exampleSentenceUz: Kanyonlar tez oquvchi daryo suvlari keltirib chiqargan yemirilish natijasida hosil bo'lgan.
englishDefinition: Erosion is the destruction of rock or soil due to flowing water or weather.

definition: Ethics are moral beliefs or rules about right or wrong.
exampleSentence: The act of stealing certainly doesn't go against some people's ethics.
uzbekDefinition: To'g'ri va noto'g'ri haqidagi axloqiy e'tiqodlar yoki qoidalar tizimi.
exampleSentenceEn: The act of stealing certainly doesn't go against some people's ethics.
exampleSentenceUz: O'g'irlik qilish ayrim odamlarning axloq qoidalariga mutlaqo zid kelmaydi shekilli.
englishDefinition: Ethics are moral beliefs or rules about right or wrong.

definition: If something is explicit, it is very clear, open, and truthful.
exampleSentence: The man gave a very explicit account of the car accident.
uzbekDefinition: Juda aniq, yashirilmagan va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri bayon etilgan.
exampleSentenceEn: The man gave a very explicit account of the car accident.
exampleSentenceUz: U kishi avtohalokat haqida juda aniq va batafsil so'zlab berdi.
englishDefinition: If something is explicit, it is very clear, open, and truthful.

definition: A framework is a set of rules or ideas that people use to solve problems.
exampleSentence: His ideas fit into the framework of a successful business plan.
uzbekDefinition: Odamlar muammolarni hal qilishda foydalanadigan qoidalar yoki g'oyalar majmui.
exampleSentenceEn: His ideas fit into the framework of a successful business plan.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning g'oyalari muvaffaqiyatli biznes-reja tuzilmasiga juda mos tushdi.
englishDefinition: A framework is a set of rules or ideas that people use to solve problems.

definition: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.
exampleSentence: My father's company manufactures steel building materials.
uzbekDefinition: Zavod yoki fabrikada mahsulot tayyorlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: My father's company manufactures steel building materials.
exampleSentenceUz: Otamning kompaniyasi po'lat qurilish materiallarini ishlab chiqaradi.
englishDefinition: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.

definition: A mechanism is a part of a machine that performs a certain function.
exampleSentence: I can't open my car door because the locking mechanism is broke.
uzbekDefinition: Mashinaning ma'lum bir vazifani bajaradigan qismi.
exampleSentenceEn: I can't open my car door because the locking mechanism is broke.
exampleSentenceUz: Qulflash mexanizmi buzilgani uchun mashinamning eshigini ocha olmayapman.
englishDefinition: A mechanism is a part of a machine that performs a certain function.

definition: To minimize means to reduce something to the lowest possible level.
exampleSentence: I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani iloji boricha eng kichik darajagacha kamaytirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.
exampleSentenceUz: Xatolarni imkon qadar kamaytirish uchun uy vazifamni ikki marta tekshirdim.
englishDefinition: To minimize means to reduce something to the lowest possible level.

definition: Nectar is a sweet liquid produced by flowers that bees and other insects collect.
exampleSentence: Bees use nectar to make their honey.
uzbekDefinition: Asalarilar va boshqa hasharotlar yig'adigan gullar ishlab chiqaradigan shirin suyuqlik.
exampleSentenceEn: Bees use nectar to make their honey.
exampleSentenceUz: Asalarilar asal tayyorlash uchun gul sharbatidan foydalanadilar.
englishDefinition: Nectar is a sweet liquid produced by flowers that bees and other insects collect.

definition: A notion is an idea or belief about something.
exampleSentence: I have a notion that this route would get us to the beach.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsa haqidagi fikr, g'oya yoki e'tiqod.
exampleSentenceEn: I have a notion that this route would get us to the beach.
exampleSentenceUz: Bu yo'l bizni plyajga olib chiqadi degan fikrim bor.
englishDefinition: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

definition: When things are prone to some bad thing, they are likely affected by it.
exampleSentence: Some people are more prone to catching colds than others.
uzbekDefinition: Biror noxush holatga uchrash ehtimoli yuqori bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Some people are more prone to catching colds than others.
exampleSentenceUz: Ba'zi odamlar boshqalarga qaraganda shamollashga ko'proq moyil bo'ladi.
englishDefinition: When things are prone to some bad thing, they are likely affected by it.

definition: When something is straightforward, it is good because it is easy to understand.
exampleSentence: The teacher's grading system was straightforward and fair.
uzbekDefinition: Tushunishga oson, murakkab bo'lmagan va aniq.
exampleSentenceEn: The teacher's grading system was straightforward and fair.
exampleSentenceUz: O'qituvchining baholash tizimi tushunarli va adolatli edi.
englishDefinition: When something is straightforward, it is good because it is easy to understand.

definition: If something is astronomical, then it is extremely large.
exampleSentence: It's an astronomical distance between the Milky Way galaxy and the nearest galaxy.
uzbekDefinition: Haddan tashqari katta miqdor yoki masofaga ega bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: It's an astronomical distance between the Milky Way galaxy and the nearest galaxy.
exampleSentenceUz: Somon Yo'li galaktikasi bilan eng yaqin galaktika orasidagi masofa aql bovar qilmas darajada ulkan.
englishDefinition: If something is astronomical, then it is extremely large.

definition: An atom is the smallest unit of a substance.
exampleSentence: A molecule consists of a combination of two or more atoms.
uzbekDefinition: Moddaning eng kichik bo'linmas zarrachasi.
exampleSentenceEn: A molecule consists of a combination of two or more atoms.
exampleSentenceUz: Molekula ikki yoki undan ortiq atomlarning birikmasidan tashkil topadi.
englishDefinition: An atom is the smallest unit of a substance.

definition: Breadth is the distance from one side to the other side of something.
exampleSentence: The breadth of the northern wall of the house is twenty meters.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsaning bir chetidan ikkinchi chetigacha bo'lgan masofa.
exampleSentenceEn: The breadth of the northern wall of the house is twenty meters.
exampleSentenceUz: Uyning shimoliy devorining kengligi yigirma metrni tashkil qiladi.
englishDefinition: Breadth is the distance from one side to the other side of something.

definition: A circumference is the distance completely around a circular object.
exampleSentence: The circumference of the Earth is obviously much larger than a baseball's.
uzbekDefinition: Dumaloq jismning tashqi cheti bo'ylab to'liq aylana masofasi.
exampleSentenceEn: The circumference of the Earth is obviously much larger than a baseball's.
exampleSentenceUz: Yerning aylana uzunligi beysbol to'pinikidan ancha katta ekani aniq.
englishDefinition: A circumference is the distance completely around a circular object.

definition: A comet is an object in space made of ice and rock with a tail of glowing dust.
exampleSentence: Comets take many decades to complete an orbit around a star.
uzbekDefinition: Muz va toshdan tashkil topgan, yorqin chang dumiga ega fazoviy jism.
exampleSentenceEn: Comets take many decades to complete an orbit around a star.
exampleSentenceUz: Kometalar yulduz atrofida bir marta aylanib chiqishi uchun o'nlab yillar kerak bo'ladi.
englishDefinition: A comet is an object in space made of ice and rock with a tail of glowing dust.

definition: A crater is a large hole in a planet's or moon's surface.
exampleSentence: They could clearly see the big crater on the moon through the telescope.
uzbekDefinition: Sayyora yoki Oy yuzasidagi katta chuqurlik.
exampleSentenceEn: They could clearly see the big crater on the moon through the telescope.
exampleSentenceUz: Ular teleskop orqali Oydagi katta kraterni aniq ko'ra olishdi.
englishDefinition: A crater is a large hole in a planet's or moon's surface.

definition: A crescent is the curved shape lit on the moon's face during its early and late stages.
exampleSentence: Ten days ago the entire moon was bright, but now only a small crescent is shining.
uzbekDefinition: Oyning boshlang'ich va oxirgi bosqichlarida ko'rinadigan egri shakli.
exampleSentenceEn: Ten days ago the entire moon was bright, but now only a small crescent is shining.
exampleSentenceUz: O'n kun oldin butun oy charaqlab turgan edi, hozir esa faqat ingichka hilol porlamoqda.
englishDefinition: A crescent is the curved shape lit on the moon's face during its early and late stages.

definition: Debris is the small pieces scattered from something wrecked or destroyed.
exampleSentence: The debris from the cube scattered on the floor.
uzbekDefinition: Vayron bo'lgan yoki singan narsalardan sochilib ketgan mayda bo'laklar.
exampleSentenceEn: The debris from the cube scattered on the floor.
exampleSentenceUz: Siniq parchalari polga sochilib ketdi.
englishDefinition: Debris is the small pieces scattered from something wrecked or destroyed.

definition: Despair is the complete loss of hope.
exampleSentence: After the other company won the account, our salespeople were filled with despair.
uzbekDefinition: Umidning butunlay yo'qolishi holati.
exampleSentenceEn: After the other company won the account, our salespeople were filled with despair.
exampleSentenceUz: Raqib kompaniya mijozni qo'lga kiritgach, bizning sotuvchilarimiz umidsizlikka tushishdi.
englishDefinition: Despair is the complete loss of hope.

definition: To embed something means to place it firmly within a surrounding thing.
exampleSentence: The logger embedded the ax into the wood after chopping several logs.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani boshqa muhit ichiga mahkam joylashtirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The logger embedded the ax into the wood after chopping several logs.
exampleSentenceUz: O'tinchi bir nechta g'o'lani chopgandan so'ng boltani yog'ochga mahkam qadab qo'ydi.
englishDefinition: To embed something means to place it firmly within a surrounding thing.

definition: A fragment is a small part of something.
exampleSentence: After the light broke, there were fragments of glass to clean up.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsaning sinib tushgan kichik bir qismi.
exampleSentenceEn: After the light broke, there were fragments of glass to clean up.
exampleSentenceUz: Chiroq singandan keyin tozalash kerak bo'lgan shisha parchalari qoldi.
englishDefinition: A fragment is a small part of something.

definition: A galaxy is any extremely large collection of star systems.
exampleSentence: Our solar system is located in the outer area of our galaxy.
uzbekDefinition: Yulduz tizimlarining nihoyatda katta to'plami.
exampleSentenceEn: Our solar system is located in the outer area of our galaxy.
exampleSentenceUz: Bizning Quyosh tizimimiz galaktikamizning chekka qismida joylashgan.
englishDefinition: A galaxy is any extremely large collection of star systems.

definition: If something is gigantic, then it is extremely large.
exampleSentence: Some dinosaurs were so gigantic that they were the size of buildings.
uzbekDefinition: Haddan tashqari katta o'lchamga ega bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Some dinosaurs were so gigantic that they were the size of buildings.
exampleSentenceUz: Ba'zi dinozavrlar shu qadar bahaybat ediki, binolardek kelardi.
englishDefinition: If something is gigantic, then it is extremely large.

definition: Gloom is a state of being almost completely dark.
exampleSentence: In the gloom of the morning, it was difficult to see the boat on the lake.
uzbekDefinition: Deyarli butunlay qorong'i holat yoki tushkun kayfiyat.
exampleSentenceEn: In the gloom of the morning, it was difficult to see the boat on the lake.
exampleSentenceUz: Tonggi g'ira-shirada ko'ldagi qayiqni ko'rish qiyin edi.
englishDefinition: Gloom is a state of being almost completely dark.

definition: To radiate means to send out energy or heat.
exampleSentence: The heat from the fireplace radiated throughout the room.
uzbekDefinition: Issiqlik, yorug'lik yoki energiyani atrofga tarqatmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The heat from the fireplace radiated throughout the room.
exampleSentenceUz: Kaminadan chiqayotgan issiqlik butun xonaga taraldi.
englishDefinition: To radiate means to send out energy or heat.

definition: To roam means to move around without a plan or purpose.
exampleSentence: All day the cows roamed around the field eating grass.
uzbekDefinition: Aniq reja yoki maqsadsiz u yoqdan-bu yoqqa yurmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: All day the cows roamed around the field eating grass.
exampleSentenceUz: Kun bo'yi sigirlar dalada o't yeb aylanib yurishdi.
englishDefinition: To roam means to move around without a plan or purpose.

definition: If something is solitary, then it is lonely or the only one.
exampleSentence: The only thing in the room was a solitary chair.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa hech kim yoki hech narsa bo'lmagan, yolg'iz holat.
exampleSentenceEn: The only thing in the room was a solitary chair.
exampleSentenceUz: Xonadagi yagona narsa yakka o'zi turgan stul edi.
englishDefinition: If something is solitary, then it is lonely or the only one.

definition: The spectrum is the full range of color ranging from red to violet.
exampleSentence: You can see the entire spectrum in a rainbow.
uzbekDefinition: Qizildan binafsharangacha bo'lgan barcha ranglar qatori yoki keng doira.
exampleSentenceEn: You can see the entire spectrum in a rainbow.
exampleSentenceUz: Kamalakda butun ranglar spektrini ko'rishingiz mumkin.
englishDefinition: The spectrum is the full range of color ranging from red to violet.

definition: A sphere is a three-dimensional round shape, like a ball.
exampleSentence: The balloons were inflated into a variety of colorful spheres.
uzbekDefinition: Koptok kabi uch o'lchamli dumaloq shakl.
exampleSentenceEn: The balloons were inflated into a variety of colorful spheres.
exampleSentenceUz: Sharlar puflanib, turli xil rang-barang koptok shakllariga keltirildi.
englishDefinition: A sphere is a three-dimensional round shape, like a ball.

definition: Status is the position of something or someone in relation to others.
exampleSentence: She had achieved the status of being the smartest girl in the class.
uzbekDefinition: Birovning yoki narsaning boshqalarga nisbatan tutgan o'rni.
exampleSentenceEn: She had achieved the status of being the smartest girl in the class.
exampleSentenceUz: U sinfdagi eng aqlli qiz maqomiga erishgan edi.
englishDefinition: Status is the position of something or someone in relation to others.

definition: If someone is bankrupt, then they are unable to pay their debts.
exampleSentence: The store had few customers and soon went bankrupt.
uzbekDefinition: Qarzlarini to'lashga qodir bo'lmay qolgan holat.
exampleSentenceEn: The store had few customers and soon went bankrupt.
exampleSentenceUz: Do'konda mijozlar kam bo'lgani uchun tez orada bankrot bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: If someone is bankrupt, then they are unable to pay their debts.

definition: To conform to rules or laws is to obey them.
exampleSentence: The new student had to conform to the school's dress code.
uzbekDefinition: Qoida, qonun yoki tartib-intizomga amal qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The new student had to conform to the school's dress code.
exampleSentenceUz: Yangi o'quvchi maktabning kiyinish qoidalariga rioya qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: To conform to rules or laws is to obey them.

definition: To employ someone means to give work to them.
exampleSentence: The bookstore employed two full-time clerks.
uzbekDefinition: Kimgadir maosh evaziga ish bermoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The bookstore employed two full-time clerks.
exampleSentenceUz: Kitob do'koni ikki nafar to'liq stavkali sotuvchini ishga oldi.
englishDefinition: To employ someone means to give work to them.

definition: To expel someone means to force them to leave a place.
exampleSentence: Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.
uzbekDefinition: Kimnidir biror joydan majburan chiqarib yubormoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Since he would not follow the rules, the principal had to expel the student.
exampleSentenceUz: Qoidalarga bo'ysunmagani uchun direktor o'quvchini maktabdan haydashga majbur bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: To expel someone means to force them to leave a place.

definition: An extension is a part added to something to give it more time or space.
exampleSentence: My parents decided to add an extension to our house for the new baby.
uzbekDefinition: Ko'proq joy yoki vaqt berish uchun biror narsaga qo'shilgan qism.
exampleSentenceEn: My parents decided to add an extension to our house for the new baby.
exampleSentenceUz: Ota-onam yangi chaqaloq uchun uyimizga qo'shimcha xona qurishga qaror qilishdi.
englishDefinition: An extension is a part added to something to give it more time or space.

definition: If something is forthcoming, then it is about to happen in the future.
exampleSentence: Some economists predicted that the forthcoming world economy would be severe.
uzbekDefinition: Tez orada kelajakda sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Some economists predicted that the forthcoming world economy would be severe.
exampleSentenceUz: Ba'zi iqtisodchilar yaqinlashib kelayotgan jahon iqtisodiyoti og'ir bo'lishini bashorat qilishdi.
englishDefinition: If something is forthcoming, then it is about to happen in the future.

definition: To furnish means to put furniture in a house or room.
exampleSentence: Most homes are furnished with tables, chairs, and beds.
uzbekDefinition: Uy yoki xonani mebel va zarur buyumlar bilan ta'minlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Most homes are furnished with tables, chairs, and beds.
exampleSentenceUz: Ko'pchilik uylar stol, stul va karavotlar bilan jihozlanadi.
englishDefinition: To furnish means to put furniture in a house or room.

definition: Hygiene is the conditions or methods needed for health and cleanliness.
exampleSentence: People who brush their teeth at least twice a day are practicing good hygiene.
uzbekDefinition: Salomatlik va ozodalikni saqlash uchun zarur bo'lgan sharoit va usullar.
exampleSentenceEn: People who brush their teeth at least twice a day are practicing good hygiene.
exampleSentenceUz: Kuniga kamida ikki marta tishlarini yuvadigan odamlar yaxshi gigiyenaga rioya qiladilar.
englishDefinition: Hygiene is the conditions or methods needed for health and cleanliness.

definition: If something is hygienic, then it is clean and unlikely to cause disease.
exampleSentence: My sister works very hard to keep her entire home as hygienic as possible.
uzbekDefinition: Kasallik tarqalishining oldini oladigan darajada toza.
exampleSentenceEn: My sister works very hard to keep her entire home as hygienic as possible.
exampleSentenceUz: Opam butun uyini imkon qadar gigiyenik saqlash uchun juda ko'p mehnat qiladi.
englishDefinition: If something is hygienic, then it is clean and unlikely to cause disease.

definition: A landlord is a man who rents property to a person.
exampleSentence: The landlord collected everyone's rent money on the first day of every month.
uzbekDefinition: Odamga uy-joy yoki mulkni ijaraga beruvchi kishi.
exampleSentenceEn: The landlord collected everyone's rent money on the first day of every month.
exampleSentenceUz: Uy egasi har oyning birinchi kunida hammadan ijara pulini yig'ib olardi.
englishDefinition: A landlord is a man who rents property to a person.

definition: To lease means to rent property, usually an apartment or land.
exampleSentence: When the family first leased the apartment, the rent was very low.
uzbekDefinition: Odatda kvartira yoki yerni ma'lum muddatga ijaraga olmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: When the family first leased the apartment, the rent was very low.
exampleSentenceUz: Oila kvartirani birinchi marta ijaraga olganida, ijara haqi juda past edi.
englishDefinition: To lease means to rent property, usually an apartment or land.

definition: If something is mandatory, then it is required by law.
exampleSentence: It's mandatory that everyone be at least sixteen to drive a car in the US.
uzbekDefinition: Qonun yoki qoida bo'yicha bajarilishi shart bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: It's mandatory that everyone be at least sixteen to drive a car in the US.
exampleSentenceUz: AQShda mashina haydash uchun har bir kishi kamida o'n olti yoshda bo'lishi majburiydir.
englishDefinition: If something is mandatory, then it is required by law.

definition: To mend something means to fix it when it is broken or damaged.
exampleSentence: Mother mended the rip in my pants with a piece of cloth.
uzbekDefinition: Singan yoki yirtilgan narsani tuzatib asl holiga keltirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Mother mended the rip in my pants with a piece of cloth.
exampleSentenceUz: Onam shimimdagi yirtiqni mato parchasi bilan yamab berdi.
englishDefinition: To mend something means to fix it when it is broken or damaged.

definition: A mortgage is a loan for property, especially homes and businesses.
exampleSentence: When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.
uzbekDefinition: Uy-joy yoki bino sotib olish uchun olinadigan garovli kredit.
exampleSentenceEn: When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.
exampleSentenceUz: Yangi uy sotib olishganda, er-xotin ipoteka shartnomasini imzolashga majbur bo'lishdi.
englishDefinition: A mortgage is a loan for property, especially homes and businesses.

definition: Personnel are employees in a business.
exampleSentence: When business increased, we had to hire more personnel.
uzbekDefinition: Tashkilot yoki korxonada ishlaydigan barcha xodimlar.
exampleSentenceEn: When business increased, we had to hire more personnel.
exampleSentenceUz: Biznesimiz kengayganida, ko'proq xodimlar yollashimizga to'g'ri keldi.
englishDefinition: Personnel are employees in a business.

definition: Plumbing is the system of pipes used in a home to supply water.
exampleSentence: When the plumbing stopped working, no one was allowed to use the toilets.
uzbekDefinition: Uyni suv bilan ta'minlaydigan va chiqindi suvni chiqaradigan quvurlar tizimi.
exampleSentenceEn: When the plumbing stopped working, no one was allowed to use the toilets.
exampleSentenceUz: Suv quvurlari tizimi ishlamay qolganda, hech kimga hojatxonadan foydalanishga ruxsat berilmadi.
englishDefinition: Plumbing is the system of pipes used in a home to supply water.

definition: A tenant is a person who rents property from a landlord.
exampleSentence: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.
uzbekDefinition: Uy egasidan mulkni ijaraga olib yashovchi yoki foydalanuvchi shaxs.
exampleSentenceEn: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.
exampleSentenceUz: Yangi ijarachilar ko'chaning narigi tomonidagi uyga ko'chib o'tishdi.
englishDefinition: A tenant is a person who rents property from a landlord.

definition: If something is trendy, then it is very popular and new.
exampleSentence: Carlo bought a trendy new car.
uzbekDefinition: Ayni paytda juda mashhur va yangi urfdagi.
exampleSentenceEn: Carlo bought a trendy new car.
exampleSentenceUz: Karlo zamonaviy yangi mashina sotib oldi.
englishDefinition: If something is trendy, then it is very popular and new.

definition: A utility is a business that supplies services such as water or electricity.
exampleSentence: If you don't pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.
uzbekDefinition: Suv yoki elektr energiyasi kabi asosiy xizmatlarni yetkazib beruvchi tarmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: If you don't pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.
exampleSentenceUz: Kommunal to'lovlarni to'lamasangiz, elektr energiyangiz o'chirib qo'yilishi mumkin.
englishDefinition: A utility is a business that supplies services such as water or electricity.

definition: Whereby means by which or through which.
exampleSentence: The mayor had a new bridge built whereby the citizens could cross the river.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsa amalga oshiriladigan vosita yoki usulni bildiruvchi bog'lovchi.
exampleSentenceEn: The mayor had a new bridge built whereby the citizens could cross the river.
exampleSentenceUz: Hokim fuqarolar daryodan o'ta olishlari uchun yangi ko'prik qurdirdi.
englishDefinition: Whereby means by which or through which.

definition: If something is aesthetic, then it is concerned with a love of beauty.
exampleSentence: The dresses were noteworthy for their aesthetic design.
uzbekDefinition: Go'zallik va nafislikni qadrlash bilan bog'liq bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: The dresses were noteworthy for their aesthetic design.
exampleSentenceUz: Ko'ylaklar o'zining nafis estetik dizayni bilan alohida e'tiborga loyiq edi.
englishDefinition: If something is aesthetic, then it is concerned with a love of beauty.

definition: If someone is arrogant, they think that they are more important than others.
exampleSentence: He is very arrogant. Even though he's not the boss, he tells everyone what to do.
uzbekDefinition: O'zini boshqalardan ustun va muhimroq deb biladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: He is very arrogant. Even though he's not the boss, he tells everyone what to do.
exampleSentenceUz: U juda dimog'dor. Boshliq bo'lmasa ham, hammaga buyruq berib yuradi.
englishDefinition: If someone is arrogant, they think that they are more important than others.

definition: A bias is a person's likelihood to like one thing more than another thing.
exampleSentence: The mothers had a natural bias for their own child's picture.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani boshqasidan asossiz ravishda ustun qo'yish moyilligi.
exampleSentenceEn: The mothers had a natural bias for their own child's picture.
exampleSentenceUz: Onalarda o'z farzandining rasmiga nisbatan tabiiy tarafkashlik bor edi.
englishDefinition: A bias is a person's likelihood to like one thing more than another thing.

definition: A canyon is a narrow valley with steep walls through which a river often flows.
exampleSentence: The canyon was so deep that the ground inside was covered in shadow.
uzbekDefinition: Odatda ichidan daryo oqib o'tadigan tik qoyali tor vodiy.
exampleSentenceEn: The canyon was so deep that the ground inside was covered in shadow.
exampleSentenceUz: Kanyon shu qadar chuqur ediki, uning tubi soya bilan qoplangan edi.
englishDefinition: A canyon is a narrow valley with steep walls through which a river often flows.

definition: A creek is a stream or small river.
exampleSentence: Only small fish lived in the shallow waters of the creek.
uzbekDefinition: Kichik daryo yoki tabiiy suv oqimi.
exampleSentenceEn: Only small fish lived in the shallow waters of the creek.
exampleSentenceUz: Jilg'aning sayoz suvlarida faqat kichik baliqlar yashar edi.
englishDefinition: A creek is a stream or small river.

definition: A drill is a tool with a point that spins in order to make a hole.
exampleSentence: The carpenter used the drill to make several holes in the wood.
uzbekDefinition: Teshik ochish uchun aylanuvchi uchli asbob.
exampleSentenceEn: The carpenter used the drill to make several holes in the wood.
exampleSentenceUz: Duradgor yog'ochda bir nechta teshik ochish uchun parmadan foydalandi.
englishDefinition: A drill is a tool with a point that spins in order to make a hole.

definition: An executive is the top manager of a business.
exampleSentence: After twenty years at the company, he finally became the executive.
uzbekDefinition: Kompaniya yoki tashkilotning eng yuqori lavozimli rahbari.
exampleSentenceEn: After twenty years at the company, he finally became the executive.
exampleSentenceUz: Kompaniyadagi yigirma yillik mehnatidan so'ng u nihoyat boshqaruvchi rahbar bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: An executive is the top manager of a business.

definition: Fatigue is a feeling of extreme tiredness.
exampleSentence: After three days with little sleep, she was feeling a lot of fatigue.
uzbekDefinition: Jismoniy yoki ruhiy jihatdan o'ta toliqqanlik hissi.
exampleSentenceEn: After three days with little sleep, she was feeling a lot of fatigue.
exampleSentenceUz: Uch kun kam uxlaganidan keyin u qattiq charchoqni his qilayotgan edi.
englishDefinition: Fatigue is a feeling of extreme tiredness.

definition: An incline is a sharp rise in something, especially a hill or mountain.
exampleSentence: This mountain has one of the steepest inclines in the world.
uzbekDefinition: Ayniqsa tepalik yoki tog'dagi keskin ko'tarilish yoki qiyalik.
exampleSentenceEn: This mountain has one of the steepest inclines in the world.
exampleSentenceUz: Bu tog' dunyodagi eng tik qiyaliklardan biriga ega.
englishDefinition: An incline is a sharp rise in something, especially a hill or mountain.

definition: If something is nasty, then it is not nice or pleasant.
exampleSentence: The rotten apple left a nasty taste inside her mouth.
uzbekDefinition: Yoqimli bo'lmagan, jirkanish uyg'otadigan yoki zararli.
exampleSentenceEn: The rotten apple left a nasty taste inside her mouth.
exampleSentenceUz: Chirigan olma uning og'zida yoqimsiz ta'm qoldirdi.
englishDefinition: If something is nasty, then it is not nice or pleasant.

definition: To perceive something means to be aware of it.
exampleSentence: He was talking loudly, so he did not perceive that the music had stopped.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani ko'rib, eshitib yoki his qilib payqamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: He was talking loudly, so he did not perceive that the music had stopped.
exampleSentenceUz: U baland ovozda gapirayotgani uchun musiqa to'xtaganini payqamadi.
englishDefinition: To perceive something means to be aware of it.

definition: A primate is a type of mammal that includes monkeys, apes, and humans.
exampleSentence: Primates use their hands for such tasks as swinging from branches.
uzbekDefinition: Maymunlar, odamsimon maymunlar va insonlarni o'z ichiga olgan sutemizuvchilar turkumi.
exampleSentenceEn: Primates use their hands for such tasks as swinging from branches.
exampleSentenceUz: Primatlar shoxdan-shoxga sakrash kabi harakatlar uchun qo'llaridan foydalanadilar.
englishDefinition: A primate is a type of mammal that includes monkeys, apes, and humans.

definition: If something is primitive, then it is simple, basic, and not very developed.
exampleSentence: The computers of the 1980s are primitive compared to those of today's.
uzbekDefinition: Qadimiy, juda oddiy va texnologik jihatdan rivojlanmagan.
exampleSentenceEn: The computers of the 1980s are primitive compared to those of today's.
exampleSentenceUz: 1980-yillarning kompyuterlari bugungilariga nisbatan ancha sodda va ibtidoiy.
englishDefinition: If something is primitive, then it is simple, basic, and not very developed.

definition: A stereotype is a general but often incorrect idea about a person or thing.
exampleSentence: There's a stereotype that pigs are dirty animals. But they are rather clean.
uzbekDefinition: Biror shaxs yoki guruh haqidagi umumlashgan, ko'pincha noto'g'ri tushuncha.
exampleSentenceEn: There's a stereotype that pigs are dirty animals. But they are rather clean.
exampleSentenceUz: Cho'chqalar iflos hayvonlar degan noto'g'ri stereotip bor, lekin ular aslida ancha toza.
englishDefinition: A stereotype is a general but often incorrect idea about a person or thing.

definition: If something is sticky, then it is covered with a substance that things stick to.
exampleSentence: Place the sticky part of the tape against the paper, so it will cling to the wall.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa narsalar yopishib qoladigan modda bilan qoplangan.
exampleSentenceEn: Place the sticky part of the tape against the paper, so it will cling to the wall.
exampleSentenceUz: Skotchning yopishqoq tomonini qog'ozga bosing, shunda u devorga mahkam yopishadi.
englishDefinition: If something is sticky, then it is covered with a substance that things stick to.

definition: A termite is an insect that lives in groups and feeds on wood.
exampleSentence: The wood we found was full of termites.
uzbekDefinition: Guruh bo'lib yashaydigan va yog'och bilan oziqlanadigan hasharot.
exampleSentenceEn: The wood we found was full of termites.
exampleSentenceUz: Biz topgan yog'och termitlar bilan to'la edi.
englishDefinition: A termite is an insect that lives in groups and feeds on wood.

definition: If something happens thereby an action, then it is the result of that action.
exampleSentence: He didn't score a goal, thereby ending his chance at setting a record.
uzbekDefinition: Biror harakat natijasida kelib chiqishini bildiruvchi ravish.
exampleSentenceEn: He didn't score a goal, thereby ending his chance at setting a record.
exampleSentenceUz: U gol ura olmadi va shu tariqa rekord o'rnatish imkoniyatidan mahrum bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: If something happens thereby an action, then it is the result of that action.

definition: A trail is a path through a wild area.
exampleSentence: A narrow trail cut through the field and over the hills.
uzbekDefinition: Yovvoyi tabiat yoki o'rmon ichidan o'tgan tor yo'l.
exampleSentenceEn: A narrow trail cut through the field and over the hills.
exampleSentenceUz: Tor so'qmoq dala va tepaliklar bo'ylab cho'zilgan edi.
englishDefinition: A trail is a path through a wild area.

definition: A twig is a short and thin branch from a tree or bush.
exampleSentence: They started the fire with a handful of dry twigs.
uzbekDefinition: Daraxt yoki butaning ingichka va kalta shoxchasi.
exampleSentenceEn: They started the fire with a handful of dry twigs.
exampleSentenceUz: Ular bir siqim quruq shoxchalar bilan olov yoqishdi.
englishDefinition: A twig is a short and thin branch from a tree or bush.

definition: Welfare is the health and happiness of a person or group.
exampleSentence: Having plenty of clean water is necessary for the welfare of people.
uzbekDefinition: Shaxs yoki jamiyatning sog'lom, xavfsiz va baxtli yashash holati.
exampleSentenceEn: Having plenty of clean water is necessary for the welfare of people.
exampleSentenceUz: Toza suvning yetarli bo'lishi odamlarning farovonligi uchun zarurdir.
englishDefinition: Welfare is the health and happiness of a person or group.

definition: If something is done on one's behalf, it is done for that person by another.
exampleSentence: The original speaker was sick, so his son gave the speech on his behalf.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa bir kishi o'rniga yoki uning manfaati uchun qilingan ish.
exampleSentenceEn: The original speaker was sick, so his son gave the speech on his behalf.
exampleSentenceUz: Asosiy ma'ruzachi kasal bo'lib qolgani uchun uning o'g'li uning nomidan nutq so'zladi.
englishDefinition: If something is done on one's behalf, it is done for that person by another.

definition: To flap means to move quickly up and down or from side to side.
exampleSentence: The tiny bird flapped its wings and ate from the flowers.
uzbekDefinition: Tezlik bilan yuqoriga-pastga yoki u yoqdan-bu yoqqa harakatlanmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The tiny bird flapped its wings and ate from the flowers.
exampleSentenceUz: Kichkina qush qanotlarini qoqib, gullardan oziqlandi.
englishDefinition: To flap means to move quickly up and down or from side to side.

definition: A glacier is a large piece of ice that moves very slowly.
exampleSentence: The North Pole is covered by a huge glacier.
uzbekDefinition: Juda sekin siljiydigan ulkan muz qatlami.
exampleSentenceEn: The North Pole is covered by a huge glacier.
exampleSentenceUz: Shimoliy qutb ulkan muzlik bilan qoplangan.
englishDefinition: A glacier is a large piece of ice that moves very slowly.

definition: The globe refers to the Earth.
exampleSentence: Water covers most of the globe.
uzbekDefinition: Yer sayyorasi yoki uning dumaloq modeli.
exampleSentenceEn: Water covers most of the globe.
exampleSentenceUz: Yer sharining katta qismini suv qoplab turadi.
englishDefinition: The globe refers to the Earth.

definition: When something is horizontal, it is flat and level with the ground.
exampleSentence: The Russian flag has three horizontal stripes of white, blue, and red.
uzbekDefinition: Yer sirtiga parallel ravishda tekis joylashgan.
exampleSentenceEn: The Russian flag has three horizontal stripes of white, blue, and red.
exampleSentenceUz: Rossiya bayrog'ida oq, ko'k va qizil rangli uchta gorizontal chiziq bor.
englishDefinition: When something is horizontal, it is flat and level with the ground.

definition: To hum means to make a low, continuous noise.
exampleSentence: The man hummed his favorite song.
uzbekDefinition: Lablarni yumgan holda past, uzluksiz tovush chiqarmoq yoki xirgoyi qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The man hummed his favorite song.
exampleSentenceUz: U kishi sevimli qo'shig'ini past ovozda xirgoyi qilib borardi.
englishDefinition: To hum means to make a low, continuous noise.

definition: An inventory is a supply of something.
exampleSentence: Gwen was checking the inventory to make sure we had what we needed.
uzbekDefinition: Mavjud mahsulotlar yoki narsalar zaxirasi yoxud ro'yxati.
exampleSentenceEn: Gwen was checking the inventory to make sure we had what we needed.
exampleSentenceUz: Gven bizda kerakli narsalar borligiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun zaxirani tekshirayotgan edi.
englishDefinition: An inventory is a supply of something.

definition: If a thought or feeling is inward, it is not expressed or shown to others.
exampleSentence: She had an inward feeling of guilt when she lied to her mother.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqalarga ko'rsatilmaydigan ichki his yoki fikr.
exampleSentenceEn: She had an inward feeling of guilt when she lied to her mother.
exampleSentenceUz: Onasiga yolg'on gapirganida, u ich-ichidan aybdorlik hissini tuydi.
englishDefinition: If a thought or feeling is inward, it is not expressed or shown to others.

definition: A loaf of bread is bread shaped and baked in one piece.
exampleSentence: Could you please buy a loaf of bread for sandwiches?
uzbekDefinition: Bir bo'lak qilib shakl berib pishirilgan butun non.
exampleSentenceEn: Could you please buy a loaf of bread for sandwiches?
exampleSentenceUz: Iltimos, sendvich tayyorlash uchun bir buxanka non sotib olib kelasizmi?
englishDefinition: A loaf of bread is bread shaped and baked in one piece.

definition: An oracle is person who speaks with gods and gives advice about the future.
exampleSentence: The king went to the oracle to ask if going to war was a good idea.
uzbekDefinition: Ilohlar bilan muloqot qilib, kelajak haqida maslahat beruvchi deb ishonilgan shaxs.
exampleSentenceEn: The king went to the oracle to ask if going to war was a good idea.
exampleSentenceUz: Qirol urushga borish yaxshi fikrmi-yo'qmi so'rash uchun bashoratchining oldiga bordi.
englishDefinition: An oracle is person who speaks with gods and gives advice about the future.

definition: To orbit something means to move around it in a continuous, curving path.
exampleSentence: The moon orbits the Earth.
uzbekDefinition: Boshqa jism atrofida uzluksiz egri chiziq bo'ylab harakatlanmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The moon orbits the Earth.
exampleSentenceUz: Oy Yer atrofida orbita bo'ylab aylanadi.
englishDefinition: To orbit something means to move around it in a continuous, curving path.

definition: An overview is a general description of a situation.
exampleSentence: My brother gave me an overview of the important parts of the book.
uzbekDefinition: Vaziyat yoki asar haqidagi umumiy va qisqacha tavsif.
exampleSentenceEn: My brother gave me an overview of the important parts of the book.
exampleSentenceUz: Akam menga kitobning muhim qismlari haqida umumiy sharh berdi.
englishDefinition: An overview is a general description of a situation.

definition: A preview is an opportunity to see something before it is available to the public.
exampleSentence: The band played us a preview of their new song.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsa ommaga taqdim etilishidan oldin uni ko'rish imkoniyati.
exampleSentenceEn: The band played us a preview of their new song.
exampleSentenceUz: Musiqiy guruh bizga yangi qo'shig'ining qisqa namoyishini ijro etib berdi.
englishDefinition: A preview is an opportunity to see something before it is available to the public.

definition: If something is previous, then it happened earlier in time or order.
exampleSentence: He turned back to the previous page to read the paragraph again.
uzbekDefinition: Vaqt yoki tartib bo'yicha ilgari sodir bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: He turned back to the previous page to read the paragraph again.
exampleSentenceUz: U xatboshini yana o'qish uchun oldingi sahifaga qaytdi.
englishDefinition: If something is previous, then it happened earlier in time or order.

definition: To provide something means to supply it.
exampleSentence: Each student was provided with a test and three sharp pencils.
uzbekDefinition: Kimgadir kerakli narsani yetkazib bermoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Each student was provided with a test and three sharp pencils.
exampleSentenceUz: Har bir o'quvchi test va uchta o'tkirlangan qalam bilan ta'minlandi.
englishDefinition: To provide something means to supply it.

definition: To recur means to happen more than once.
exampleSentence: Burglaries seem to recur over and over in our neighborhood.
uzbekDefinition: Bir necha marta qayta-qayta sodir bo'lmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Burglaries seem to recur over and over in our neighborhood.
exampleSentenceUz: Mahallamizda o'g'irliklar qayta-qayta takrorlanayotganga o'xshaydi.
englishDefinition: To recur means to happen more than once.

definition: When something is relevant, it is important to a certain person or situation.
exampleSentence: The thirty-year-old book about politics is still relevant to our society today.
uzbekDefinition: Ma'lum bir shaxs yoki vaziyat uchun muhim va bog'liq bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: The thirty-year-old book about politics is still relevant to our society today.
exampleSentenceUz: Siyosat haqidagi o'ttiz yillik kitob bugungi jamiyatimiz uchun hamon dolzarbdir.
englishDefinition: When something is relevant, it is important to a certain person or situation.

definition: A rite is a traditional ceremony carried out by a particular group or society.
exampleSentence: Special masks are worn during the rite when a new baby is born.
uzbekDefinition: Ma'lum bir guruh yoki jamiyatda o'tkaziladigan an'anaviy marosim.
exampleSentenceEn: Special masks are worn during the rite when a new baby is born.
exampleSentenceUz: Yangi chaqaloq tug'ilganda o'tkaziladigan marosim paytida maxsus niqoblar taqiladi.
englishDefinition: A rite is a traditional ceremony carried out by a particular group or society.

definition: To stall means to stop a process and continue it at a later time.
exampleSentence: If you give the car a push, it won't stall.
uzbekDefinition: Jarayonni to'xtatib qo'ymoq yoki motor o'chib qolmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: If you give the car a push, it won't stall.
exampleSentenceUz: Agar mashinani itarib yuborsangiz, u o'chib qolmaydi.
englishDefinition: To stall means to stop a process and continue it at a later time.

definition: If something is supernatural, it is not real or explainable by natural law.
exampleSentence: The dragon had supernatural powers such as flying and breathing fire.
uzbekDefinition: Haqiqiy bo'lmagan va tabiat qonunlari bilan tushuntirib bo'lmaydigan.
exampleSentenceEn: The dragon had supernatural powers such as flying and breathing fire.
exampleSentenceUz: Ajdarhoning uchish va olov purkash kabi g'ayritabiiy kuchlari bor edi.
englishDefinition: If something is supernatural, it is not real or explainable by natural law.

definition: To adapt means to change in order to deal with a new situation or addition.
exampleSentence: When he went to the new town, he had to adapt to all the weather changes.
uzbekDefinition: Yangi sharoit yoki o'zgarishga moslashish uchun o'zgarmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: When he went to the new town, he had to adapt to all the weather changes.
exampleSentenceUz: U yangi shaharga borganida, ob-havodagi barcha o'zgarishlarga moslashishga majbur bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: To adapt means to change in order to deal with a new situation or addition.

definition: Biological describes the process of life and living things.
exampleSentence: In science, we learned about the biological process of bacterial growth.
uzbekDefinition: Hayot va tirik organizmlar jarayonlariga tegishli.
exampleSentenceEn: In science, we learned about the biological process of bacterial growth.
exampleSentenceUz: Tabiatshunoslik darsida biz bakteriyalarning o'sishidagi biologik jarayon haqida o'rgandik.
englishDefinition: Biological describes the process of life and living things.

definition: When something is cellular, it relates to the cells of animals or plants.
exampleSentence: She used a microscope to see the activity at a cellular level.
uzbekDefinition: Hayvon yoki o'simlik hujayralariga tegishli bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: She used a microscope to see the activity at a cellular level.
exampleSentenceUz: U hujayra darajasidagi faollikni ko'rish uchun mikroskopdan foydalandi.
englishDefinition: When something is cellular, it relates to the cells of animals or plants.

definition: When people are dynamic, they are lively and have creative ideas.
exampleSentence: The new, dynamic employee came up with a good way to juggle his work load.
uzbekDefinition: G'ayratli va ijodiy g'oyalarga boy bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: The new, dynamic employee came up with a good way to juggle his work load.
exampleSentenceUz: Yangi, g'ayratli xodim o'z ish yuklamasini boshqarishning yaxshi yo'lini o'ylab topdi.
englishDefinition: When people are dynamic, they are lively and have creative ideas.

definition: A fantasy is a pleasant situation that people think about but is unlikely to happen.
exampleSentence: Becoming an astronaut is a fantasy shared by many children.
uzbekDefinition: Odamlar o'ylaydigan, lekin ro'yobga chiqishi dargumon bo'lgan yoqimli holat.
exampleSentenceEn: Becoming an astronaut is a fantasy shared by many children.
exampleSentenceUz: Kosmonavt bo'lish ko'plab bolalar orzu qiladigan shirin xayoldir.
englishDefinition: A fantasy is a pleasant situation that people think about but is unlikely to happen.

definition: Heredity is the process of passing on features from parents to children.
exampleSentence: The boy's face is similar to his father's because of heredity.
uzbekDefinition: Xususiyatlarning ota-onadan farzandlarga o'tish jarayoni.
exampleSentenceEn: The boy's face is similar to his father's because of heredity.
exampleSentenceUz: Irsiylik tufayli bolaning yuzi otasinikiga juda o'xshaydi.
englishDefinition: Heredity is the process of passing on features from parents to children.

definition: When something is internal, it exists or happens inside a person, object, or place.
exampleSentence: We removed the outer case to reveal the computer's internal wires.
uzbekDefinition: Biror kishi, narsa yoki joyning ichkarisida mavjud bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: We removed the outer case to reveal the computer's internal wires.
exampleSentenceUz: Kompyuterning ichki simlarini ko'rish uchun tashqi qopqog'ini yechib oldik.
englishDefinition: When something is internal, it exists or happens inside a person, object, or place.

definition: When something is minimal, it is very small.
exampleSentence: My lazy husband does a minimal amount of work around the house.
uzbekDefinition: Miqdori yoki hajmi juda kichik bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: My lazy husband does a minimal amount of work around the house.
exampleSentenceUz: Dangasa erim uy ishlarining juda oz qismini bajaradi.
englishDefinition: When something is minimal, it is very small.

definition: A pioneer is a person who is the first to discover or be involved in something.
exampleSentence: He was a pioneer of computer programming.
uzbekDefinition: Biror sohani birinchi bo'lib kashf etgan yoki boshlab bergan shaxs.
exampleSentenceEn: He was a pioneer of computer programming.
