definition: If something is linguistic, then it is concerned with language.
exampleSentence: A linguistic way of studying culture focuses on words within that culture.
uzbekDefinition: Til va tilshunoslik bilan bog'liq bo'lgan.
exampleSentenceEn: A linguistic way of studying culture focuses on words within that culture.
exampleSentenceUz: Madaniyatni o'rganishning lingvistik usuli o'sha madaniyatdagi so'zlarga e'tibor qaratadi.
englishDefinition: If something is linguistic, then it is concerned with language.

definition: If someone is monolingual, then they speak only one language.
exampleSentence: In today's global economy, being monolingual limits your opportunities.
uzbekDefinition: Faqatgina bitta tilda gaplasha oladigan.
exampleSentenceEn: In today's global economy, being monolingual limits your opportunities.
exampleSentenceUz: Bugungi global iqtisodiyotda faqat bitta tilni bilish imkoniyatlaringizni cheklaydi.
englishDefinition: If someone is monolingual, then they speak only one language.

definition: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.
exampleSentence: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.
uzbekDefinition: Insonning qaysi mamlakat yoki millatga mansubligi.
exampleSentenceEn: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning fuqaroligi nemis, lekin u fransuz, ispan va koreys tillarida gaplasha oladi.
englishDefinition: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.

definition: A patriot is someone who loves, supports, and defends their country.
exampleSentence: Every year young patriots join their countries' militaries.
uzbekDefinition: O'z vatanini sevadigan, qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan va himoya qiladigan kishi.
exampleSentenceEn: Every year young patriots join their countries' militaries.
exampleSentenceUz: Har yili yosh vatanparvarlar o'z mamlakatlari qurolli kuchlari safiga qo'shilishadi.
englishDefinition: A patriot is someone who loves, supports, and defends their country.

definition: To prosecute someone means to take legal action against them.
exampleSentence: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.
uzbekDefinition: Kimgadir qarshi sudda rasmiy ayblov qo'zg'atmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.
exampleSentenceUz: Ular ruxsatnomasiz daryoda baliq ovlaganliklari uchun javobgarlikka tortildilar.
englishDefinition: To prosecute someone means to take legal action against them.

definition: If something is racial, then it is related to a race or races.
exampleSentence: The differences between racial groups are physical characteristics and culture.
uzbekDefinition: Inson irqlari o'rtasidagi munosabat yoki farqlarga tegishli.
exampleSentenceEn: The differences between racial groups are physical characteristics and culture.
exampleSentenceUz: Irqiy guruhlar o'rtasidagi farqlar jismoniy xususiyatlar va madaniyatdan iborat.
englishDefinition: If something is racial, then it is related to a race or races.

definition: If something is solemn, then it is serious and honest.
exampleSentence: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.
uzbekDefinition: Hazil-huzulsiz, juda jiddiy va samimiy.
exampleSentenceEn: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.
exampleSentenceUz: Professor talabalari bilan o'zaro munosabatining jiddiy va rasmiy bo'lishini afzal ko'rar edi.
englishDefinition: If something is solemn, then it is serious and honest.

definition: Solidarity is a union formed from common responsibilities or interests.
exampleSentence: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.
uzbekDefinition: Umumiy manfaat va maqsad yo'lida birlashish va qo'llab-quvvatlash.
exampleSentenceEn: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.
exampleSentenceUz: Barcha fuqarolar o'zgarish yaratish uchun birdamlik namoyish etib birlashdilar.
englishDefinition: Solidarity is a union formed from common responsibilities or interests.

definition: Tact is the ability to avoid offending people when dealing with problems.
exampleSentence: Since both sides would not agree, it required someone with tact to make peace.
uzbekDefinition: Muammolarni hal qilishda boshqalarni ranjitmaslik mahorati.
exampleSentenceEn: Since both sides would not agree, it required someone with tact to make peace.
exampleSentenceUz: Ikki tomon kelisha olmagani uchun tinchlik o'rnatishga muomalasi nozik odam kerak bo'ldi.
englishDefinition: Tact is the ability to avoid offending people when dealing with problems.

definition: To undermine someone means to betray or weaken their efforts or authority.
exampleSentence: The documents helped to undermine the workers' trust in their bosses' honesty.
uzbekDefinition: Kimningdir obro'sini, ishonchini yoki kuchini yashirincha susaytirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The documents helped to undermine the workers' trust in their bosses' honesty.
exampleSentenceUz: Hujjatlar ishchilarning rahbarlari halolligiga bo'lgan ishonchini susaytirishga xizmat qildi.
englishDefinition: To undermine someone means to betray or weaken their efforts or authority.

definition: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.
exampleSentence: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
uzbekDefinition: Ma'lum maqsad yoki shaxs uchun mablag', vaqt yoki resurs ajratib qo'ymoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
exampleSentenceUz: Hukumat tabiiy ofat oqibatlarini bartaraf etishga yordam berish uchun 100 million dollar ajratdi.
englishDefinition: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.

definition: When food is appetizing, it looks and smells very good.
exampleSentence: The appetizing plate of cookies was gone in half an hour.
uzbekDefinition: Ko'rinishi va hidi juda yoqimli bo'lib, yegingizni keltiradigan.
exampleSentenceEn: The appetizing plate of cookies was gone in half an hour.
exampleSentenceUz: Ishtaha ochar pechenyeli tarelka yarim soat ichida bo'shab qoldi.
englishDefinition: When food is appetizing, it looks and smells very good.

definition: A blizzard is a severe snow storm with strong winds.
exampleSentence: We did not dare to go outside during the terrible blizzard.
uzbekDefinition: Kuchli shamol bilan kechadigan qattiq qor bo'roni.
exampleSentenceEn: We did not dare to go outside during the terrible blizzard.
exampleSentenceUz: Dahshatli qor bo'roni paytida tashqariga chiqishga jur'at eta olmadik.
englishDefinition: A blizzard is a severe snow storm with strong winds.

definition: A cavity is a hole or space in something.
exampleSentence: There was a small cavity in the wall of the cave where an animal lived.
uzbekDefinition: Qattiq narsa ichidagi teshik yoki bo'shliq.
exampleSentenceEn: There was a small cavity in the wall of the cave where an animal lived.
exampleSentenceUz: G'or devorida hayvon yashaydigan kichik kovak bor edi.
englishDefinition: A cavity is a hole or space in something.

definition: If something moves clockwise, it moves in a circle in the same direction as a clock.
exampleSentence: Turn the screw clockwise to tighten it.
uzbekDefinition: Soat millari harakatlanadigan yo'nalishda aylanma harakat.
exampleSentenceEn: Turn the screw clockwise to tighten it.
exampleSentenceUz: Vintni mahkamlash uchun uni soat strelkasi yo'nalishida aylantiring.
englishDefinition: If something moves clockwise, it moves in a circle in the same direction as a clock.

definition: When circles or rings are concentric, they have the same center.
exampleSentence: The target was a series of concentric circles.
uzbekDefinition: Bir xil umumiy markazga ega bo'lgan doiralar.
exampleSentenceEn: The target was a series of concentric circles.
exampleSentenceUz: Nishon markazi bir bo'lgan bir qator doiralardan iborat edi.
englishDefinition: When circles or rings are concentric, they have the same center.

definition: Courtesy is the excellence of manners or social conduct.
exampleSentence: Jenna always behaves with great courtesy when people visit her home.
uzbekDefinition: Go'zal xulq va boshqalarga hurmat ko'rsatish odati.
exampleSentenceEn: Jenna always behaves with great courtesy when people visit her home.
exampleSentenceUz: Jenna uyiga mehmonlar kelganda doim katta xushmuomalalik bilan muomala qiladi.
englishDefinition: Courtesy is the excellence of manners or social conduct.

definition: When food is crisp, it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.
exampleSentence: My favorite snack is a bag of crisp, delicious potato chips.
uzbekDefinition: Taom haqida — yoqimli qarsildoq; havo haqida — toza va salqin.
exampleSentenceEn: My favorite snack is a bag of crisp, delicious potato chips.
exampleSentenceUz: Mening eng sevimli tamaddim — bir paket qarsildoq, mazali kartoshka chipslari.
englishDefinition: When food is crisp, it is hard or has a hard surface in a way that is pleasant.

definition: Discord is disagreement or fighting between people.
exampleSentence: There was much discord between the experts on the talk show.
uzbekDefinition: Odamlar o'rtasidagi kelishmovchilik va janjal.
exampleSentenceEn: There was much discord between the experts on the talk show.
exampleSentenceUz: Teleko'rsatuvdagi mutaxassislar o'rtasida katta kelishmovchilik bor edi.
englishDefinition: Discord is disagreement or fighting between people.

definition: When something is frigid, it is extremely cold.
exampleSentence: We decided not to go on the hike because the weather was too frigid.
uzbekDefinition: Haddan tashqari sovuq va ayozli.
exampleSentenceEn: We decided not to go on the hike because the weather was too frigid.
exampleSentenceUz: Ob-havo juda sovuq bo'lgani uchun piyoda sayrga chiqmaslikka qaror qildik.
englishDefinition: When something is frigid, it is extremely cold.

definition: To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.
exampleSentence: The mayor promised to generate new jobs and programs to help the poor.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani vujudga keltirmoq yoki hosil qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The mayor promised to generate new jobs and programs to help the poor.
exampleSentenceUz: Hokim kambag'allarga yordam berish uchun yangi ish o'rinlari va dasturlar yaratishga va'da berdi.
englishDefinition: To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.

definition: When something is glacial, it relates to large masses of ice that move slowly.
exampleSentence: Penguins thrive in the glacial regions of Antarctica.
uzbekTranslation: muzlikka oid, muzdek sovuq, juda sekin
uzbekDefinition: Muzliklarga tegishli yoki haddan tashqari sovuq.
exampleSentenceEn: Penguins thrive in the glacial regions of Antarctica.
exampleSentenceUz: Pingvinlar Antarktidaning muzli hududlarida yaxshi yashaydilar.
englishDefinition: When something is glacial, it relates to large masses of ice that move slowly.

definition: An interchange of ideas between people is a discussion of each person's idea.
exampleSentence: There was an interchange of ideas between the groups.
uzbekDefinition: Odamlar o'rtasida g'oyalar yoki narsalarni o'zaro almashish.
exampleSentenceEn: There was an interchange of ideas between the groups.
exampleSentenceUz: Guruhlar o'rtasida qizg'in fikr almashinuvi bo'lib o'tdi.
englishDefinition: An interchange of ideas between people is a discussion of each person's idea.

definition: A locker is a small cabinet with a lock where people store their possessions.
exampleSentence: I keep my school books in my locker.
uzbekDefinition: Shaxsiy buyumlarni saqlash uchun qulflanadigan kichik shkaf.
exampleSentenceEn: I keep my school books in my locker.
exampleSentenceUz: Men maktab kitoblarimni shkafchamda saqlayman.
englishDefinition: A locker is a small cabinet with a lock where people store their possessions.

definition: When something is multicultural, it relates to many different cultures.
exampleSentence: Everyone was welcomed to attend the multicultural celebration.
uzbekDefinition: Turli xil madaniyatlarni o'z ichiga olgan.
exampleSentenceEn: Everyone was welcomed to attend the multicultural celebration.
exampleSentenceUz: Hamma ko'p madaniyatli bayram tadbirida qatnashishga taklif qilindi.
englishDefinition: When something is multicultural, it relates to many different cultures.

definition: An omission is something that has been left out or not done.
exampleSentence: Mike was upset because of the omission of his name during the ceremony.
uzbekDefinition: Nazoratdan chetda qolib kiritilmay yoki bajarilmay qolgan narsa.
exampleSentenceEn: Mike was upset because of the omission of his name during the ceremony.
exampleSentenceUz: Marosim paytida uning ismi tushirib qoldirilgani Maykni xafa qildi.
englishDefinition: An omission is something that has been left out or not done.

definition: To oversee something means to make sure that it is being done properly.
exampleSentence: His job was to oversee the progress of the construction project.
uzbekDefinition: Ishning to'g'ri bajarilishini kuzatib va boshqarib turmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: His job was to oversee the progress of the construction project.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning vazifasi qurilish loyihasining borishini nazorat qilish edi.
englishDefinition: To oversee something means to make sure that it is being done properly.

definition: To pierce something means to make a hole in it using a sharp object.
exampleSentence: The arrow pierced the target in the very center.
uzbekDefinition: O'tkir narsa bilan teshik ochmoq yoki kirib bormoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The arrow pierced the target in the very center.
exampleSentenceUz: O'q nishonning qoq markazini teshib kirdi.
englishDefinition: To pierce something means to make a hole in it using a sharp object.

definition: To replicate something is to do it in the exact same way as someone before.
exampleSentence: I would love to replicate my father's achievements in school.
uzbekDefinition: Oldin kimdir qilgan ishni aynan xuddi o'sha tarzda bajarmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: I would love to replicate my father's achievements in school.
exampleSentenceUz: Otamning maktabdagi yutuqlarini aynan takrorlashni juda xohlardim.
englishDefinition: To replicate something is to do it in the exact same way as someone before.

definition: When something is wavy, it is not straight but has a series of curves.
exampleSentence: The child drew wavy lines all over the piece of paper.
uzbekDefinition: To'g'ri emas, to'lqinga o'xshash egri chiziqlarga ega.
exampleSentenceEn: The child drew wavy lines all over the piece of paper.
exampleSentenceUz: Bola butun qog'oz bo'ylab to'lqinsimon chiziqlar chizdi.
englishDefinition: When something is wavy, it is not straight but has a series of curves.

definition: To abide by something, like a rule, means to obey it.
exampleSentence: If you want to play the game with us, you must be willing to abide by our rules.
uzbekDefinition: Qoida, qonun yoki qarorga bo'ysunib amal qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: If you want to play the game with us, you must be willing to abide by our rules.
exampleSentenceUz: Agar biz bilan o'yin o'ynashni istasangiz, qoidalarimizga rioya qilishga tayyor bo'lishingiz kerak.
englishDefinition: To abide by something, like a rule, means to obey it.

definition: Conversion is the act of changing something into a different state or form.
exampleSentence: The city discussed the conversion of the parking lot into a skateboard park.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsani boshqa shakl yoki holatga aylantirish jarayoni.
exampleSentenceEn: The city discussed the conversion of the parking lot into a skateboard park.
exampleSentenceUz: Shahar kengashi avtoturargohni skeytbord parkiga aylantirish masalasini muhokama qildi.
englishDefinition: Conversion is the act of changing something into a different state or form.

definition: To cram things means to put them into a place that can barely contain them.
exampleSentence: He crammed all of his shirts into the top drawer of the dresser.
uzbekDefinition: Narsalarni deyarli joy qolmagan joyga zichlab tiqmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: He crammed all of his shirts into the top drawer of the dresser.
exampleSentenceUz: U barcha ko'ylaklarini komodning yuqori tortmasiga tiqishtirib joyladi.
englishDefinition: To cram things means to put them into a place that can barely contain them.

definition: To defer means to arrange for an action to happen at a later time.
exampleSentence: The girl was very sleepy, so she chose to defer her bath until morning.
uzbekDefinition: Biror ishni keyinroq vaqtga qoldirmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The girl was very sleepy, so she chose to defer her bath until morning.
exampleSentenceUz: Qizning juda uyqusi kelayotgan edi, shuning uchun u cho'milishni ertalabga qoldirishni tanladi.
englishDefinition: To defer means to arrange for an action to happen at a later time.

definition: To export products means to sell them to other countries.
exampleSentence: The United States exports many cereals and grains.
uzbekDefinition: Mahsulotlarni boshqa mamlakatlarga sotib yubormoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The United States exports many cereals and grains.
exampleSentenceUz: Amerika Qo'shma Shtatlari ko'plab donli ekinlar va g'allalarni eksport qiladi.
englishDefinition: To export products means to sell them to other countries.

definition: Fumes are unhealthy smoke and gases that are made by fires or chemicals.
exampleSentence: The engine put unpleasant, black fumes into the air.
uzbekDefinition: Olov yoki kimyoviy moddalardan chiqadigan zararli tutun va gaz.
exampleSentenceEn: The engine put unpleasant, black fumes into the air.
exampleSentenceUz: Dvigatel havoga yoqimsiz qora tutun chiqarar edi.
englishDefinition: Fumes are unhealthy smoke and gases that are made by fires or chemicals.

definition: When something is habitual, it is a behavior that a person usually does or has.
exampleSentence: The man was a habitual liar who was incapable of being honest with the police.
uzbekDefinition: Kishi muntazam ravishda qiladigan odatiy xulq-atvor.
exampleSentenceEn: The man was a habitual liar who was incapable of being honest with the police.
exampleSentenceUz: U politsiyaga ham rost gapira olmaydigan ashaddiy, odatiy yolg'onchi edi.
englishDefinition: When something is habitual, it is a behavior that a person usually does or has.

definition: To justify something means to show or prove that it is necessary.
exampleSentence: The government tried to justify its decision to bring the country into a war.
uzbekDefinition: Biror ish yoki qarorning to'g'ri va zarur ekanligini isbotlamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The government tried to justify its decision to bring the country into a war.
exampleSentenceUz: Hukumat mamlakatni urushga olib kirish qarorini asoslashga harakat qildi.
englishDefinition: To justify something means to show or prove that it is necessary.

definition: Output is the amount of something that a person or thing produces.
exampleSentence: The boss hired more workers to increase the factory's output of products.
uzbekDefinition: Biror shaxs yoki korxona ishlab chiqaradigan mahsulot miqdori.
exampleSentenceEn: The boss hired more workers to increase the factory's output of products.
exampleSentenceUz: Boshliq zavodning mahsulot ishlab chiqarish hajmini oshirish uchun ko'proq ishchilar yolladi.
englishDefinition: Output is the amount of something that a person or thing produces.

definition: Overpopulation is the state of having too many people in an area.
exampleSentence: The organization is concerned with overpopulation of the world.
uzbekDefinition: Bir hududda aholining me'yordan ortiq ko'payib ketishi holati.
exampleSentenceEn: The organization is concerned with overpopulation of the world.
exampleSentenceUz: Tashkilot dunyoda aholining haddan tashqari ko'payib ketishidan xavotirda.
englishDefinition: Overpopulation is the state of having too many people in an area.

definition: A patent is a right to be the only person allowed to make or sell a new product.
exampleSentence: He quickly established a patent for his brilliant invention.
uzbekDefinition: Yangi ixtiro yoki mahsulotni faqat o'zi ishlab chiqarish va sotish huquqi.
exampleSentenceEn: He quickly established a patent for his brilliant invention.
exampleSentenceUz: U o'zining ajoyib ixtirosi uchun tezda patent oldi.
englishDefinition: A patent is a right to be the only person allowed to make or sell a new product.

definition: To penalize someone means to punish him or her.
exampleSentence: The team was penalized when they broke the rules.
uzbekDefinition: Qoidani buzgani uchun kimgadir jazo yoki jarima belgilamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The team was penalized when they broke the rules.
exampleSentenceUz: Jamoa qoidalarni buzganida jazoga tortildi.
englishDefinition: To penalize someone means to punish him or her.

definition: Petroleum is a liquid natural resource from which many fuels are made.
exampleSentence: The petroleum at that factory is used to make gasoline.
uzbekDefinition: Yer ostidan olinadigan va benzin kabi ko'plab yoqilg'ilar tayyorlanadigan tabiiy suyuq boylik.
exampleSentenceEn: The petroleum at that factory is used to make gasoline.
exampleSentenceUz: O'sha zavoddagi neftdan benzin ishlab chiqarish uchun foydalaniladi.
englishDefinition: Petroleum is a liquid natural resource from which many fuels are made.

definition: A prototype is a new machine that is not ready to be made in large quantities.
exampleSentence: He introduced his prototype to the motorcycle company.
uzbekDefinition: Ommaviy ishlab chiqarishdan oldin tayyorlangan yangi qurilmaning birinchi namunasi.
exampleSentenceEn: He introduced his prototype to the motorcycle company.
exampleSentenceUz: U o'zining ilk tajriba namunasini mototsikl kompaniyasiga taqdim etdi.
englishDefinition: A prototype is a new machine that is not ready to be made in large quantities.

definition: A scrap of something is a small amount of it.
exampleSentence: Chris liked to use many scraps of paper when thinking up ideas.
uzbekDefinition: Biror narsaning kichik bo'lagi yoki parcha qog'oz.
exampleSentenceEn: Chris liked to use many scraps of paper when thinking up ideas.
exampleSentenceUz: Kris g'oyalar o'ylab topayotganida ko'plab qog'oz parchalaridan foydalanishni yoqtirardi.
englishDefinition: A scrap of something is a small amount of it.

definition: A sector is a part of a country's economy in a specific type of industry.
exampleSentence: We learned about just a few of the factories within the manufacturing sector.
uzbekDefinition: Mamlakat iqtisodiyotining yoki jamiyatning ma'lum bir tarmog'i.
exampleSentenceEn: We learned about just a few of the factories within the manufacturing sector.
exampleSentenceUz: Biz ishlab chiqarish tarmog'idagi atigi bir nechta zavodlar haqida o'rgandik.
englishDefinition: A sector is a part of a country's economy in a specific type of industry.

definition: To subscribe to something is to agree or to concur with it.
exampleSentence: She subscribed to the view that musical education should be kept in schools.
uzbekDefinition: Nashrga obuna bo'lmoq yoki biror fikrga qo'shilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: She subscribed to the view that musical education should be kept in schools.
exampleSentenceUz: U maktablarda musiqa ta'limi saqlanib qolishi kerak degan fikrga qo'shildi.
englishDefinition: To subscribe to something is to agree or to concur with it.

definition: To subsist means to have the food, water, and money needed to stay alive.
exampleSentence: Some people are forced to subsist on only a few dollars a month.
uzbekDefinition: Tirik qolish uchun zarur bo'lgan minimal oziq-ovqat va mablag' bilan amallab yashamoq.
exampleSentenceEn: Some people are forced to subsist on only a few dollars a month.
exampleSentenceUz: Ba'zi odamlar oyiga atigi bir necha dollar bilan kun kechirishga majbur.
englishDefinition: To subsist means to have the food, water, and money needed to stay alive.

definition: To suspend something means to delay or stop it from happening for a while.
exampleSentence: The oil company suspended production until it was sure the factory was safe.
uzbekDefinition: Jarayonni bir muddatga kechiktirmoq yoki to'xtatib qo'ymoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The oil company suspended production until it was sure the factory was safe.
exampleSentenceUz: Neft kompaniyasi zavod xavfsiz ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilmaguncha ishlab chiqarishni vaqtincha to'xtatdi.
englishDefinition: To suspend something means to delay or stop it from happening for a while.

definition: A synthesis is a combination of different ideas or styles.
exampleSentence: The band's music was a synthesis of many different musical genres.
uzbekDefinition: Turli g'oyalar, uslublar yoki moddalarning yaxlit birikmasi.
exampleSentenceEn: The band's music was a synthesis of many different musical genres.
exampleSentenceUz: Guruhning musiqasi ko'plab turli musiqiy janrlarning sintezi edi.
englishDefinition: A synthesis is a combination of different ideas or styles.

definition: An acrobat is a person who entertains people by doing amazing physical things.
exampleSentence: There were acrobats at the circus that did impressive and complicated jumps.
uzbekDefinition: Sirkda murakkab jismoniy mashqlar bilan tomoshabinlarni hayratda qoldiradigan artist.
exampleSentenceEn: There were acrobats at the circus that did impressive and complicated jumps.
exampleSentenceUz: Sirkda ta'sirchan va murakkab sakrashlarni bajaradigan akrobatlar bor edi.
englishDefinition: An acrobat is a person who entertains people by doing amazing physical things.

definition: Advocacy is the act of supporting or recommending something.
exampleSentence: Janine's strong advocacy for the event made people want to attend.
uzbekDefinition: Biror g'oya yoki ishni faol qo'llab-quvvatlash va tavsiya qilish.
exampleSentenceEn: Janine's strong advocacy for the event made people want to attend.
exampleSentenceUz: Janinning tadbirni qattiq qo'llab-quvvatlashi odamlarda unda qatnashish istagini uyg'otdi.
englishDefinition: Advocacy is the act of supporting or recommending something.

definition: If something is communal, it involves a group of people.
exampleSentence: On the weekends, Theo and his son picked up trash in the communal park.
uzbekDefinition: Bir guruh odamlar birgalikda foydalanadigan yoki bajaradigan.
exampleSentenceEn: On the weekends, Theo and his son picked up trash in the communal park.
exampleSentenceUz: Dam olish kunlari Teo va o'g'li jamoat bog'idagi chiqindilarni terib tozalashardi.
englishDefinition: If something is communal, it involves a group of people.

definition: If something is fluid, it is smooth and moves gracefully.
exampleSentence: Boris was a famous ballet dancer because people admired his fluid movements.
uzbekDefinition: Harakatlari silliq va nafis; yoki suyuqlik holatida.
exampleSentenceEn: Boris was a famous ballet dancer because people admired his fluid movements.
exampleSentenceUz: Boris mashhur balet raqqosi edi, chunki odamlar uning silliq va nafis harakatlariga qoyil qolishardi.
englishDefinition: If something is fluid, it is smooth and moves gracefully.

definition: To harmonize means to make different things go well together.
exampleSentence: The sweet and sour flavors of the dish harmonized well and tasted great.
uzbekDefinition: Turli narsalarni bir-biriga yaxshi moslashtirib yoqimli natija hosil qilmoq.
exampleSentenceEn: The sweet and sour flavors of the dish harmonized well and tasted great.
exampleSentenceUz: Taomning shirin va nordon ta'mlari bir-biri bilan ajoyib uyg'unlashib, juda mazali chiqdi.
englishDefinition: To harmonize means to make different things go well together.

definition: Moss is a small green or yellow plant that grows on wet dirt, rocks, or tree trunks.
exampleSentence: Be careful not to slip on the moss that's covering those rocks.
uzbekDefinition: Nam tuproq, tosh yoki daraxt tanalarida o'sadigan mayda yashil o'simlik.
exampleSentenceEn: Be careful not to slip on the moss that's covering those rocks.
exampleSentenceUz: O'sha toshlarni qoplab turgan yo'sinda sirpanib ketmaslik uchun ehtiyot bo'ling.
englishDefinition: Moss is a small green or yellow plant that grows on wet dirt, rocks, or tree trunks.

definition: When a bird pecks, it bites or hits something with its beak.
exampleSentence: The birds pecked at the seeds on the ground.
uzbekDefinition: Qushning tumshug'i bilan urishi yoki don yeyishi.
exampleSentenceEn: The birds pecked at the seeds on the ground.
exampleSentenceUz: Qushlar yerdagi donlarni cho'qib yeyishdi.
englishDefinition: When a bird pecks, it bites or hits something with its beak.

definition: A pebble is a small, round stone.
exampleSentence: We threw pebbles into the lake to make the water splash.
uzbekDefinition: Kichkina dumaloq tosh.
exampleSentenceEn: We threw pebbles into the lake to make the water splash.
exampleSentenceUz: Suv sachratish uchun ko'lga mayda toshchalar otdik.
englishDefinition: A pebble is a small, round stone.

definition: A reservoir is a place for storing water for a town to use.
exampleSentence: If it doesn't rain soon, the reservoir is going to dry up completely.
uzbekDefinition: Shahar yoki hududni ta'minlash uchun suv saqlanadigan sun'iy yoki tabiiy havza.
exampleSentenceEn: If it doesn't rain soon, the reservoir is going to dry up completely.
exampleSentenceUz: Agar tez orada yomg'ir yog'masa, suv ombori butunlay qurib qoladi.
englishDefinition: A reservoir is a place for storing water for a town to use.

definition: A streak is a long, thin mark that is easy to see.
exampleSentence: Her hair was brown except for a streak which she dyed blonde.
uzbekDefinition: Oson ko'rinadigan uzun va ingichka chiziq yoki iz.
exampleSentenceEn: Her hair was brown except for a streak which she dyed blonde.
exampleSentenceUz: Uning sochlari jigarrang edi, faqat sariq rangga bo'yagan bitta chizig'idan tashqari.
englishDefinition: A streak is a long, thin mark that is easy to see.
